Title: Assistant Manager - Pouching
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Pouching Department

**Department:**Production – Pouching  
**Reports To:**Production Manager / Plant Head

1. Job PurposeTo manage and control all pouching operations to achieve production targets, optimum machine utilization, required quality standards, on-time delivery, minimum wastage, and efficient manpower utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and company procedures.2. Key Responsibilities**A. Production Planning and Execution**

* Execute daily and monthly production plans as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimum utilization of pouching machines, manpower, and available resources.
* Monitor production output, machine speeds, efficiency, downtime, and order completion.
* Ensure timely changeovers, job preparation, and smooth production flow.
* Coordinate with Planning, Printing, Lamination, Slitting, QA, Maintenance, departments.
* Take corrective action to recover production losses and meet daily targets.

**B. Productivity and Cost Control**

* Achieve defined targets for output, productivity, machine utilization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), where applicable.
* Minimize material wastage, start-up rejection, sealing defects, and pouching losses.
* Monitor production performance against established standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Improve machine running speeds and reduce setup, changeover, and idle time.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase capacity and reduce conversion costs.

**C. Quality Management**

* Ensure production conforms to approved specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters such as sealing temperature, pressure, dwell time, registration, dimensions, zipper alignment, gusset formation, and cutting accuracy, as applicable to the pouch type.
* Ensure first-piece approval and regular in-process quality checks.
* Prevent defects such as seal leakage, wrinkles, misregistration, poor cutting, contamination, and dimensional variation.
* Ensure traceability, correct material identification, and proper recording of production and quality data.
* Coordinate with QA to investigate non-conformities, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure rejected and non-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled.

**D. Manpower Management**

* Allocate operators and helpers according to machine loading and production priorities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operator performance.
* Develop operator skills through training, coaching, and competency assessments.
* Ensure proper shift handover and effective communication between shifts.
* Build a multi-skilled workforce to improve operational flexibility.

**E. Machine Maintenance and Performance**

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor recurring breakdowns and implement measures to reduce downtime.
* Ensure machines, tools, sealing jaws, cutting systems, and other accessories are maintained in good working condition.
* Ensure proper machine settings, changeover practices, and equipment handling.
* Report technical issues and recommend improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**F. Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company safety rules, machine guarding, and lockout/tagout procedures where applicable.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, and cleanliness throughout the department.
* Ensure safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment.
* Promote a safety-first culture and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, food-contact packaging, hygiene, and customer requirements.

**G. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily production and shift performance reports.
* Monitor output, efficiency, downtime, wastage, rejection, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure accurate recording of production data in ERP systems.
* Analyze performance gaps and submit action plans to the Production Manager.
* Maintain records of machine settings, quality checks, changeovers, downtime, and material reconciliation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated against approved departmental targets for:

* Production output versus plan.
* Machine efficiency and utilization.
* Downtime and breakdown losses.
* Material wastage and rejection percentage.
* Quality defects and customer complaints.
* On-time order completion.
* Setup and changeover time.
* Manpower productivity and overtime control.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Safety, housekeeping, and audit compliance.
* ERP data accuracy and timely reporting.
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction.

4. Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* 12-15 years of experience in pouching department experience; out of which 3 to 4 yrs as pouching in charge or AM pouching
* Experience in operating and managing pouching machines for different pouch formats, such as three-side seal, centre seal, stand-up pouch, zipper pouch, flat bottom 3 D pouch , quad pouch and other applicable formats.
* Knowledge of flexible packaging materials, laminates, sealing characteristics, pouch specifications, and defect analysis.
* Experience in production planning, manpower management, troubleshooting, quality control, and productivity improvement.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, production reporting, Excel, and root-cause analysis.

5. Required Competencies

* Strong production planning and execution skills.
* Leadership and manpower management.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Knowledge of pouching technology, process parameters and various pouching machine tools for all purposes.
* Focus on quality, productivity, waste reduction, and cost control.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional departments.
* Accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement mindset.

6. Authority and Accountability

* Allocate manpower and machines according to the approved production plan.
* Adjust machine settings within approved process specifications.
* Stop production when critical quality or safety issues are identified.
* Escalate material shortages, major breakdowns, quality deviations, and delivery risks.
* Recommend process improvements, training, and maintenance interventions.
* Accountable for departmental production performance, product quality, wastage, safety, and manpower utilization.

**Overall Accountability: To** ensure safe, efficient, cost-effective, and quality-compliant pouching operations while consistently achieving production and delivery targets.

Pay: AED7,500.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Manager, Managed Services (Contract)
Description:
**Manager, Managed Services (Contract)**

The Contract Manager, Managed Services is responsible for the daily delivery and continued growth of Redapt's MSP operations, which include CSP and multi-cloud support offerings. MSP operations is the primary focus of the role. The Manager leads the support team, owns the supporting tools and processes, and serves as the senior technical escalation point, drawing on hyperscaler cloud infrastructure experience as the customer base grows. This is a proactive operating role: the Manager is expected to anticipate problems, spot risks and trends early, and act before customers are affected, rather than managing by reaction to tickets and escalations. This is a contract position for a defined term, with the possibility of extension based on business need.

**Engagement Details**

* Contract engagement; the initial term is up to 6 months, with potential extension based on performance and business need.

* Engaged as a contractor, either directly or through a staffing partner; not eligible for Redapt employee benefits during the contract term.

* Work is expected to begin with a 30/60/90-day plan covering operational assessment, quick wins, and priority improvements, with regular check-ins with the Director, Managed Services.

* Availability for escalation coverage as needed to support 24x7 operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Oversee reliable, round-the-clock MSP operations across tiered support (Tier 1 through Tier 3), monitoring, and escalations, including shift handoffs across U.S. and global teams, with an emphasis on preventing incidents rather than only responding to them.

* Ensure performance against SLAs, response and resolution targets, and quality standards, and act on SLA risk before a target is missed.

* Maintain operational visibility into ticket volume, backlog, escalation trends, recurring incidents, utilization, and capacity, and use it to anticipate problems and intervene early.

* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex troubleshooting and cloud architecture issues, and establish clear escalation paths and accountability across team leads.

* Drive root-cause resolution of recurring issues to reduce incident volume over time.

* Develop runbooks, monitoring standards, and proactive practices (health checks, monitoring tuning, service reviews) so issues are resolved before customers report them, and promote automation and AI tooling to improve quality and efficiency.

**Tooling & Platforms**

* Administer the documentation and credential management platforms, set configuration standards and access controls, and maintain clear system-of-record ownership.

* Evaluate monitoring and help desk tools, working with internal stakeholders and vendors.

**People Leadership**

* Set clear performance expectations and hold the team accountable for customer outcomes, service quality, teamwork, and operational discipline.

* Coach team leads and provide consistent feedback and development guidance.

* Manage workload, utilization, and capacity, and align staffing to current and anticipated demand.

* Enable the team to adopt and use AI tools effectively by setting expectations, providing training and guidance, and measuring efficiency gains in resolution time, ticket handling, and capacity.

**Commercial & Practice Performance**

* Manage the operational drivers of financial performance, including utilization, capacity, delivery efficiency, and service quality, and flag agreement or service trends that create customer or financial risk.

* Provide timely reporting on operating metrics, risks, and opportunities, and partner with the Director, Managed Services on forecasting and resource recommendations.

**Partnership & Growth**

* Partner with the Director, Managed Services to execute MSP strategy and priorities, bringing forward operational insight, resource needs, risks, and opportunities.

* Work with Sales, Professional Services, and Finance to set realistic customer expectations and support smooth onboarding and transitions.

* Help refine MSP service offerings, including the move from standard cloud monitoring toward more tailored infrastructure monitoring, and maintain working relationships with cloud partner programs (Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud).

* Identify unmet customer needs and expansion opportunities and connect them to the right Redapt resources. Ongoing customer relationship management and technical account management are outside the scope of this role.

* Assess the operating model and staffing needs of the team, and provide the Director, Managed Services with a recommendation on the long-term structure of this role, including whether it should be filled as a permanent position in the next fiscal year.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in managed services, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years leading technical teams, with the ability to become productive quickly in a short-term engagement.

* Experience managing a 24x7 or follow-the-sun service operation with defined SLAs and tiered escalation.

* Hands-on experience with each of the major public clouds (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud), including multi-account or multi-subscription governance, logging, security controls, and identity and access management is preferred.

* Working knowledge of PSA and RMM tools and ITSM practices, including SLA, incident, and problem management.

* Working understanding of Managed Services financial drivers, including utilization, capacity, and agreement performance.

* Demonstrated ability to coach team leads, manage performance, and document processes and knowledge for a smooth handoff.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and business audiences.

* Track record of managing proactively: anticipating issues, identifying trends early, and driving preventive improvements rather than operating in reactive mode.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud certifications, such as AWS Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator, or Azure equivalents.

* ITIL certification or equivalent service management training.

* Experience with FinOps, monitoring, and observability platforms.

* Experience applying automation or AI tooling to improve service desk and operations efficiency.

Title: Senior Director Information Technology
Description:
**Vacancy Status**
: Full Time, 15 Month Contract

**Position Description:**

The Toronto Region Board of Trade is seeking a Senior Director, Information Technology for a 15-month contract to lead the Board's IT team. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, you will ensure the Board's systems remain secure, reliable and well-supported, and serve as a trusted technology partner across all levels of the organization. This role oversees IT operations, business applications, vendor partnerships, cybersecurity and in-flight technology initiatives within a Microsoft-centred environment that includes Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. In addition to progressive IT leadership experience, the ideal candidate will be a clear communicator, highly collaborative, and able to step into an established environment quickly, combining sound strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:

***Technology Leadership & Execution***

* Serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and leadership team, providing clear, concise updates and recommendations.
* Ensures technology priorities remain aligned with organizational goals and carries forward in-flight initiatives to agreed milestones.
* Maintains a strong understanding of the organization’s technology environment and remains actively involved in the execution and resolution of day-to-day technology matters.
* Identifies opportunities to improve technology effectiveness, reliability and user experience, with a focus on practical solutions appropriate for a 50-100-person organization.

***AI Implementation & Adoption***

* Supports the implementation of agentic AI solutions across the organization, working with business teams and external partners to identify practical use cases, configure and test solutions, and integrate them into everyday workflows.
* Manages and supports the Board’s AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, overseeing licensing, access, configuration and technical support.
* Coordinates the technical requirements for AI implementation, including system integrations, data access, testing and deployment, ensuring appropriate security controls and human oversight in accordance with the Board’s AI use policy.
* Provides practical guidance, training and troubleshooting to help employees adopt AI tools and apply them effectively in their work.

***Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Leads, supports and develops the IT team, setting priorities and managing performance and KPIs.
* Provides service to all areas of the Board by applying business partner skills and a client service outlook.
* Allocates work effectively across the team and ensures appropriate coverage for operational priorities, projects and employee support.
* Documents key decisions and changes to support a smooth transition at the end of the contract.

***Vendor Management, Security & Compliance***

* Manages the relationships with key technology partners, including the managed services providers; monitors performance and oversees renewals and negotiations.
* Leads vendor escalations and ensures unresolved service issues are addressed quickly and effectively.
* Maintains the Board's cybersecurity posture across Azure and Microsoft 365, including identity, access and data protection.
* Upholds IT policies, including the Board's AI use policy, and supports compliance with accessibility (AODA) and privacy requirements.

***IT Operations & Service Delivery***

* Oversees the reliable day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure and technology services at both the Board’s event space at 100 Queens Quay and corporate office at 21 Melinda, including network connectivity, Wi-Fi, end-user services, collaboration tools and telephony.
* Takes a hands-on role in addressing operational issues, troubleshooting escalated concerns and coordinating resolution with internal team members and external vendors.
* Manages the IT operating calendar, including renewals, reviews and as needed event support.
* Maintains service levels and resolves escalated issues promptly.
* Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding, hardware and software provisioning, access management and equipment lifecycle requirements.

***Business Applications & Data***

* Oversees the Board's infrastructure including: CRM, marketing automation, finance, event management system, payments, website and related platforms.
* Works directly with business teams and vendors to troubleshoot issues, manage enhancements and ensure systems are configured to support operational requirements.
* Coordinates system upgrades, integrations, implementations and changes, ensuring appropriate testing, communication, documentation and employee support.
* Supports reporting and analytics through Power BI and champions low-code solutions on the Power Platform where they add value.
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows and improve productivity using existing technology.

**Your experience includes:**

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.
* Practical experience implementing or supporting AI tools and workflow automation, including technical deployment and employee adoption; experience with agentic AI solutions considered an asset.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure, connectivity, audiovisual systems and technology support across multiple locations, including corporate office and event environments.
* Proven experience managing managed service providers and external agencies, including contracts and performance.
* Solid grounding in cybersecurity practices for a cloud-first organization.
* Experience managing an IT budget and reporting to senior executives.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; experience explaining technical matters to partners at all levels.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with business units.
* Experience with Business Central, Power BI, ClickDimensions, CMS considered an asset.

**You’re often described as:**

* A steady, pragmatic leader who builds trust quickly with a new team
* A business partner first, able to translate organizational needs into practical technology solutions
* Highly organized and able to navigate competing priorities and deadlines
* A self-starter who can work independently from a structured handover
* A strong communicator, collaborative with colleagues from all levels and departments
* Security-minded, detail-oriented and accountable

**Working Conditions:**

* Full-time position, hybrid with 3-4 days in office.
* May require occasional evening and weekend work for system maintenance or emergencies.
* On-call availability for critical system issues.

**Compensation & Benefits**

TRBOT is committed to fair, equitable pay that matches the responsibility and expertise behind every role.

This role has an annual salary range of $120,000-$170,000.

At TRBOT, performance plays an important role in pay progression. As you build your skills, take on new challenges, and make an impact, your compensation will evolve to reflect that progress. Regular development check-ins with your manager keep your path clear and your momentum strong.

Title: Technical Program Manager II (6396)
Description:
**Technical Program Manager II**

itD is seeking an Incident Communications & Program Manager to support advertising platform reliability for a leading global technology organization. This role will own day-to-day incident communications, including deciding when a communication is needed, drafting it, taking it through Legal approval, and publishing it. It will also run readiness for major advertiser sales events and build AI-driven workflow automations. The ideal candidate will bring strong writing under time pressure, experience in technical, incident, or crisis communications or program coordination, hands-on use of generative AI tools, and the judgment to run recurring operational work independently, including a higher level of on-call responsibility. This is a 12-month contract with potential for extension.

**Location:** Remote - US (candidates must work in Pacific, Central, or Mountain time)

**Duration:** 12 months

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more. Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve on the incident communications on-call rotation and work with incident managers to decide whether an incident needs communications, using defined criteria (severity, revenue impact, number of affected advertisers, duration).
* Draft advertiser-facing, sales-facing, and leadership communications for incidents of all severity levels, translating technical root causes into plain, accurate language.

Description:

**About the Role:**

* The Oracle ERP Project Manager is accountable for the end-to-end planning, execution, governance and delivery of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) programs, including ERP upgrades and the implementation of the ERP for new entities.
* The role leads a blended project team of vendors, business users and IT, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget and scope, and to the required quality across Financials, SCM and Oracle Projects.
* As the single point of accountability for ERP project delivery, the role establishes project governance, manages vendors and contracts, controls scope, risks and changes, and reports progress to the ERP Steering Committee and executive management.
* The role combines strong project management discipline with hands-on Oracle EBS knowledge to align business processes with the ERP product and to drive adoption and business value.

**Responsibilities**

1. Oversee daily operations of the ERP project team, consisting of vendors, business-area employees and IT.
2. Create the project plan with input from the business and the vendor and prepare the project budget for approval by the ERP Steering Committee.
3. Establish project governance, including the Steering Committee, project boards, RACI, reporting cadence and escalation paths.
4. Maintain tracking mechanisms such as the project plan, project budget, risk analysis, issue lists, project scope and change documentation.
5. Manage scope through a formal change control process, assessing the impact of changes on schedule, cost and quality.
6. Manage vendors and implementation partners, including contracts, statements of work, milestones, deliverable acceptance and performance against SLAs.
7. Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and business requirements through quality gates, reviews and signoffs.
8. Identify potential risks and recommend mitigation plans; analyse and troubleshoot project issues accurately and on time.
9. Plan and lead the ERP upgrade lifecycle: assessment, customization impact analysis, test cycles (CRP, SIT, UAT, regression), cut-over, go-live etc.
10. Plan and lead new entity implementations: business process design and fit-gap, configuration, data migration, integrations, training, cut-over and go-live readiness.
11. Lead data migration and data quality planning with business data owners, including reconciliation and sign-off.
12. Drive organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, communications and end-user training to ensure adoption.
13. Track and report project status, KPIs, earned value, budget and benefits to the ERP Steering Committee and executive management.
14. Coordinate with ICT Infrastructure, Information Security, DBAs and Oracle Support on environments, security, patching and release planning.
15. Maintain project documentation according to PMI / PMP standards and lead lessons-learned and project closure.

**Financial Responsibilities**

* Prepare and own the project budget approved by the ERP Steering Committee.
* Monitor actual against budgeted cost, forecasts and vendor invoices against milestones.
* Manage change requests with financial impact.

**Education and certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, commerce or a related field.
* PMP or another recognized project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, PgMP) preferred.
* Agile / Scrum, ITIL or Oracle E-Business Suite certifications are an advantage.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in the Oracle E-Business Suite, with at least 5 years in project management and vendor management.
* 10+ years of demonstrated success leading implementations and improvements within Financials, SCM and Oracle Projects.
* 7+ years of technology leadership, project and vendor management.
* Proven delivery of Oracle EBS upgrade projects (e.g. to R12.2.x) and new entity / multi-entity rollouts.
* Experience in project management methodologies (PMI, Oracle AIM / OUM, hybrid Agile), tools (e.g. MS Project, Primavera, Jira) and techniques.
* Strong budgeting, financial control, risk, issue and change management skills.
* Experience in vendor selection, contract and SOW negotiation, and managing vendor performance.
* Hands-on leadership style, able to get into the detail when required, including data modelling and the nuances of business processes in the ERP product.
* Strong team player, partnering with senior / executive management and individual contributors; good team leading and mentoring skills.
* Excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication, presentation and meeting leadership skills.

**Desirable Skills**

* Exposure to Oracle Cloud ERP and cloud migration or coexistence roadmaps.
* Experience with organizational change management frameworks (e.g. Prosci ADKAR).
* Experience delivering ERP programs in large, multi-stakeholder or government-related environments.

Description:

**Salary Grade N08 ($106,400.00 -$133,00.00)**

This role requires the successful applicant to commit to an in-office work arrangement up to 5 days a week.

***About the Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB)***

*We’re here to help. When an injury or illness happens on the job, we move quickly to provide wage-loss benefits, medical coverage and support to help people get back to work. Funded by businesses, we also provide no-fault collective liability insurance and access to industry-specific health and safety information. We are one of the largest insurance organizations in North America covering over five million people in more than 300,000 workplaces across Ontario. For more information, visit wsib.ca.*

*At the WSIB, you’ll have the opportunity to:*

* *explore many career paths and follow your passion*
* *continuously learn and grow professionally*

**Join Our Team**

Are you an experienced IT infrastructure professional with a strong background in cloud technologies, infrastructure design and service delivery?

WSIB is looking for a
**Solution Manager, Infrastructure Services**
to help oversee and optimize our Network, Cloud and Data Center infrastructure services.

In this role, you'll combine your technical expertise with strategic oversight to support infrastructure operations, lead complex technology initiatives and collaborate with internal teams and external service providers to deliver reliable, secure and efficient IT solutions.

This is a technical leadership role without direct people management responsibilities, offering the opportunity to influence infrastructure strategy, drive continuous improvement and contribute to the modernization of WSIB's technology environment.

**What You'll Do**

As a Solution Manager, Infrastructure Services, you will:

* **Oversee Infrastructure Operations:**
  Support the delivery, performance and reliability of Network, Cloud and Data Center services, including incident resolution, infrastructure changes and operational risk management.
* **Lead Technology Initiatives:**
  Coordinate complex infrastructure projects, from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, deployment and operational readiness.
* **Drive Infrastructure Strategy:**
  Contribute to short- and long-term technology planning, identifying opportunities for modernization, automation and service optimization.
* **Manage Vendor Relationships:**
  Oversee external service providers, ensuring contractual commitments, service level agreements, project timelines and quality standards are met.
* **Support Financial & Resource Planning:**
  Contribute to budgets, financial forecasts, procurement activities and infrastructure capacity planning.
* **Ensure Compliance & Risk Management:**
  Support infrastructure governance, audits, security standards and proactive risk mitigation.
* **Collaborate & Provide Technical Guidance:**
  Work closely with IT teams, business stakeholders and external partners to resolve challenges, share expertise and support organizational priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

**Education Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and/or Information Technology (or equivalent education and work experience).
* Industry relevant education or certificates for design, implementation and management of infrastructure environment (e.g. ITIL, certificates from leading infrastructure product vendors such as Microsoft, Cisco, Red Hat, AWS, Google, IBM, Oracle).

**Experience Requirements**

**Minimum Experience Required:**

* 9+ years of work experience related to IT Infrastructure.
* 9+ years' experience with Network, Cloud, and Data Center services including experience in a managed infrastructure services environments.
* 5 years' experience in operational governance, project management, financial management, and/or vendor/supplier management.
* 2+ years of experience with end-to-end delivery of operations or project delivery accountability.
* Demonstrated experienced in improving the efficiency and effectiveness of IT delivery and operations.
* Experience leading complex (multi-million) projects involving internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experiences, and achievements with three or more of the following technologies: Windows, UNIX/Linux, Mainframe, Storage, Cloud (Private and Public), LAN/WAN, Firewall, Voice, Messaging, Middleware, Database, Infrastructure Security.

**Additional Technical Expertise**

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

* **Hands-on cloud experience**
  with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Oracle Cloud.
* **Infrastructure design and engineering experience**
  , including implementing and supporting cloud-based solutions.
* **Cloud networking expertise**
  , including an understanding of network architecture, connectivity and configurations.
* **Relevant certifications**
  , particularly in Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud and/or ITIL.
* Strong technical problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration and vendor management capabilities.

Experience across all three cloud platforms is not required; practical expertise in one or more is valuable.

**Why Join WSIB?**

At WSIB, you'll have the opportunity to work with evolving technologies, contribute to meaningful infrastructure initiatives and collaborate with experienced IT professionals.

You'll play an important role in enhancing the reliability, efficiency and performance of the technology services that support our organization and the people of Ontario.

**Ready to make an impact?**

If you're passionate about cloud technologies, infrastructure operations and delivering innovative IT solutions, we encourage you to apply!

We respect and value the diversity of our people. We strive to create an environment where employees can be themselves and where our differences are celebrated.

We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating inclusive experiences for both our employees and prospective employees. We invite all interested individuals to apply. This role focuses on preventing public health outbreaks, ensuring food safety, maintaining mass evacuation readiness, and auditing subcontractors. The manager leads the implementation of safety frameworks to guarantee a secure environment for thousands of high-density residential village residents.

* FLS Compliance: Partner with engineering teams to ensure fire alarms, suppression systems, and emergency exits are fully functional and free of impairments.
* Incident Investigation: Lead investigations into all incidents, near-misses, or safety breaches within the village, establishing root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Performance Monitoring: Audit operations and maintenance (O&M) and soft services subcontractors to ensure their staff strictly adhere to safety protocols.
* Permit to Work (PTW) Governance: Oversee the verification and approval of safety procedures for high-risk maintenance operations like hot work, confined space entry, or working at heights.
* Reporting & Analytics: Compile and present comprehensive weekly and monthly HSE performance statistics, incident metrics, and trend analyses to senior leadership.
* Waste Management Safety: Ensure safe handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous and municipal solid waste generated by the village population.
* Welfare Auditing: Verify that the physical living conditions, ventilation, and density of the accommodation comply with international labor welfare frameworks and local municipal laws.

* Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Globally recognized professional safety credentials such as NEBOSH International Diploma, IOSH Graduate/Chartered membership, or OSHA equivalents.
* Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in HSE, with at least 3 years management experience directly managing safety or public health operations in massive remote camps, workforce accommodations, or high-density residential assets.

Title: Assistant Claims Manager
Description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Title: Associate Director, Clinical Services - Remote
Description:
***We Are Inspired to Serve. Join us!***
----------------------------------------

The Associate Director, Clinical Services position is the central office resource for community personnel related to clinical operations in both Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living. In addition, this position will develop, facilitate, implement, and maintain the healthcare to include, operation, clinical, regulatory, and financial standards for the assigned region. In addition, this position will assist in developing tools to measure performance against the standards, assessing, and monitoring performance and intervening with a plan and/or resources to improve performance to meet or exceed established standards. The Associate Director, Clinical Services fosters a culture of delivering high quality resident care, operational efficiency, staff development and regulatory compliance.  
  
The Associate Director, Clinical Services will collaborate and form strong partnerships with the central office team, and community leadership, in various aspects of healthcare operations.

**This position requires 50% travel to assigned communities within Covenant Living portfolio. Position can work remotely from home base when not traveling.**

***MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:***

**1.****Ensuring Quality and Compliance:**

* Implementing and maintaining clinical policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and overseeing quality assurance programs.
* Collaborate with the Associate Vice President of Healthcare Regulation, Compliance, and Quality in the development, review, and implementation of regulatory, compliance, and quality programs.
* Reviewing and assisting in the development of guidelines to adhere to regulatory directives.
* Monitoring, auditing, and validating practices, identifying problems, and working with healthcare personnel to develop and implement plans to correct inconsistencies and revise standardized practices.
* Ensuring that all required documentation, including care/service plans and assessments are completed in a timely manner, and that assessments/service plans are compliant with federal and state regulations.
* Providing oversight of resident care and adherence to the facility’s customer service philosophy.

**2. Strategic Planning:**

* Developing and implementing clinical programs and initiatives to improve patient care and outcomes.

**4. Resource Management:**

* Managing clinical budgets, resources, and supplies effectively.

**5. Clinical Staff Oversight:**

* Guide, mentor, and be involved with clinical staff, including hiring, orientation, performance evaluations, and professional development.
* Participating in the interview process for healthcare leaders and other nursing leadership positions as needed.
* Providing oversight and onsite community support when key leadership is absent for extended periods of time. This includes working, with potential travel, in the capacity of interim nursing leadership when necessary for extended periods of time.
* Collaborate with and assist with facilitating the orientation and onboarding of healthcare leaders new to the Covenant Living Communities and Services system.

* Investigating suspected abuse allegations and resident injuries
* Reporting occurrences and root cause analysis completed in a timely manner.
* Assisting in coordinating action plans to minimize liability and risks because of compliance surveys. Assisting with plans of correction as needed.
* Co-authoring employee performance improvement documents for healthcare workers, as needed.

**7. Acting as the central office resource for all healthcare aspects of training and learning curriculums. Identify and coordinate the need for clinical consultants to assist community leadership to accomplish plans.**

In partnership with community leadership and central office staff, review survey reports, community plans of correction prior to submission, and collaborate on any IDR possibilities.**

Title: Gestionnaire principal, gestion de programmes, Construction de centres de données
Description:
**Req Id:**
433116
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
* Capacité à intégrer les données liées aux échéanciers, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et au transfert des livrables afin d’offrir une vision globale et intégrée du programme.
* Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes et à produire des rapports concis destinés à la haute direction.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et bonne connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans le soutien à la réalisation de projets de centres de données, d’infrastructures critiques (mission-critical), de télécommunications ou d’infrastructures hyperscale.
* Connaissance du cycle de vie des centres de données, incluant la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service (commissioning), la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Connaissance des environnements critiques liés aux systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de refroidissement, d’automatisation et contrôle, de réseaux et de sécurité.
* Expérience avec les outils Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres plateformes similaires de contrôle de projets.

Title: Senior Construction Project Manager
Description:
**About Plexcon Construction**

Plexcon Construction Inc. (plexcon.ca) is a fast-growing residential builder specializing in multiplex conversions, new multiplex builds, laneway and garden suites, additions and major renovations across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Our clients bring their own architect and design; we build it, from pre-construction to handover. We run about 15 active projects.

As our portfolio and management team continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead our Project Managers and make sure every project is properly planned, bought out, scheduled, documented and delivered within budget.

This is not an office-administration position, and it is not a site superintendent position.

We are looking for an experienced construction professional who understands how projects are built, can identify problems before they escalate, and has the authority and judgment to hold Project Managers accountable.

**Position Overview**

You lead our construction division and report directly to Ownership. Our Project Managers each run three to four projects hands-on, on site and in Procore, and they all report to you. You do not run projects of your own. You work primarily from the office and stay actively involved in the field.

You will be the central point between Ownership, Project Managers, Estimating, Accounting, subcontractors, consultants and clients, and you will make sure:

* Every trade is properly scoped, priced and under contract before it starts.
* Every project finishes within its budget.
* Project schedules are accurate and updated.
* Project Managers complete their commitments.
* Delays, cost risks and client concerns are identified early.
* Project records and compliance documents are complete.
* Company procedures are consistently followed.
* Ownership receives clear and accurate project reporting.

The right candidate will not simply report problems. They will challenge assumptions, develop solutions, assign responsibility and make sure corrective actions are completed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Trades, Scopes and Contracts**

* Receive the budget for each project by line item and trade category.
* Define the scope of work for every trade on every project.
* Source, pre-qualify and price subcontractors and suppliers; level bids and negotiate price and terms.
* Sign all subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Hand each trade to the project's PM with a clear scope, price and dates, so the PM can run the site without gaps.
* Make sure no subcontractor starts without a signed agreement, WSIB clearance certificate, certificate of insurance and Form 1000; maintain a central compliance tracker and monitor expiry dates.
* Track subcontractor performance on quality, reliability, scheduling, pricing, safety and deficiency response; maintain approved and restricted subcontractor lists.
* Monitor original contract values, approved changes and remaining balances; resolve scope gaps and contract disputes.
* Build a reliable subcontractor and supplier network.

**Budget and Cost Control**

* Be accountable for every project finishing within budget.
* Buy out each project at or under the line-item budget.
* Review job-cost, committed-cost and cost-to-complete reports with PMs; identify overruns and margin risks early and require corrective plans.
* Review and approve every client change order before it is sent to the client, and every subcontractor extra before the work proceeds; prevent unauthorized verbal commitments.
* Make sure costs are assigned to the correct projects and categories, and that approved cost and scope changes are communicated to Accounting.
* Confirm invoices match the approved contract and completed work before payment; recommend full approval, partial approval, holdback or rejection. Final payment processing remains with the Financial Controller and Ownership.

**Project Manager Leadership and Accountability**

* Directly supervise all Project Managers; assign projects and balance workload.
* Establish clear weekly priorities and performance expectations.
* Lead the weekly Project Manager operations meeting and regular project reviews with each PM.
* Hold PMs accountable for schedules, budgets, procurement, documentation, client communication and site performance.
* Train and coach PMs on planning, communication, subcontractor management and problem-solving; be their first call for questions on scope, trades, drawings, cost or clients.
* Require recovery plans for troubled projects and step in before issues become major delays, disputes or financial losses.
* Check that commitments and action items were actually completed; identify recurring performance problems, missed deadlines and weak follow-up.
* Escalate serious project or performance concerns to Ownership.
* Assist with interviewing, onboarding, training and evaluating PMs.

**Portfolio and Project Oversight**

* Maintain an accurate overview of every active project: stage, schedule, financial risks, client issues and outstanding decisions.
* Make sure every project has a clear execution plan from startup through closeout.
* Coordinate priorities and management resources across all projects.

**Scheduling and Progress Control**

* Make sure every project has a detailed baseline schedule, updated at least weekly.
* Compare planned progress against actual site progress; review critical-path activities, trade dependencies and long-lead items.
* Confirm materials, subcontractors, inspections and client decisions are aligned with the schedule.
* Identify preventable delays and require recovery schedules when projects fall behind; make sure completion dates are realistic.
* Make sure PMs maintain procurement schedules and that sites are ready to receive and install materials.
* Maintain a company-level project schedule dashboard.

**Policies, Systems and Standard Operating Procedures**

* Develop, implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the entire construction division.
* Implement standardized checklists for project startup, scheduling, procurement, change orders, payment requests, compliance, documentation and closeout.
* Train team members on company procedures, audit whether they are being followed, and take corrective action when they are not.
* Be the company's Procore expert and enforce it: make sure everyone follows protocol in Procore for daily logs, photos, RFIs, submittals, change orders and current drawings.
* Set standard folder structures and naming, and conduct regular project-file audits.
* Keep every project file organized, complete and current, and prevent critical information from remaining only in verbal conversations, texts or personal emails.

**Site Standards, Quality and Safety**

* Conduct routine site audits of every PM's projects for safety, quality, cleanliness and progress; issue written actions and follow up until closed.
* Establish and enforce quality-control procedures; require PMs to inspect and document work before it is covered.
* Make sure construction follows approved drawings, specifications and authorized changes, and that consultant reviews and inspections are coordinated.
* Track permits, inspection results, deficiencies, occupancy requirements and permit closeout; prevent work from proceeding where required approvals are missing.
* Oversee safety administration: site safety documentation, toolbox talks, incident reporting and corrective actions. This role does not replace any legally required constructor, competent supervisor or health and safety representative.

**Project Startup and Closeout**

* Run formal project startup meetings so each PM receives and understands the contract, drawings, permits, budget, schedule, trade scopes and procurement plan.
* Make sure information is properly transferred from Estimating to Construction and Accounting.
* Make sure PMs complete formal closeout: final inspections, occupancy, deficiencies, warranties, manuals, final invoices, holdbacks and client sign-offs.
* Conduct lessons-learned reviews and make sure project records are archived.

**Client and Issue Management**

* Make sure PMs communicate with clients consistently and professionally, and do not make unauthorized promises on cost or schedule.
* Monitor unresolved client concerns, selections and decisions; make sure important decisions and meeting minutes are documented.
* Step into difficult client, consultant or subcontractor situations before they escalate.

**Reporting to Ownership**

* Prepare a clear weekly portfolio report: projects behind schedule, projects at risk of exceeding budget, client and subcontractor issues, missing compliance documents, quality and safety concerns, and decisions required from Ownership.
* Implement a consistent weekly project-reporting format; review and challenge PM reports before issues reach Ownership.
* Flag staffing and resource problems and operational matters affecting cash flow.
* Lead a monthly margin review by project with the Financial Controller.
* Make sure management decisions are implemented.

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* Minimum eight years of progressive residential construction experience with a builder, general contractor or major renovation contractor.
* Experience as a Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager, Operations Manager, Senior Site Superintendent or comparable construction leader.
* Demonstrated experience supervising Project Managers or Site Supervisors, and overseeing multiple active projects at once.
* Hands-on experience defining trade scopes, buying out projects and signing subcontracts.
* Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction through closeout and warranty.

**Required Construction Knowledge**

* Residential construction sequencing and trade coordination, from excavation, underpinning and foundations through framing, MEP, building envelope and interior finishes.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, mechanical and electrical drawings and identify missing scope.
* Project budgets, committed costs, cost-to-complete forecasting, change orders, progress invoicing and holdbacks.
* Ontario Building Code, permits and inspections; Form 1000, WSIB clearances and certificates of insurance.

**Leadership Skills**

* Leadership presence and the ability to earn the respect of experienced construction professionals.
* Comfortable challenging unrealistic schedules, incomplete information and weak explanations.
* Able to hold people accountable professionally and consistently.
* Calm and effective with urgent matters, client concerns and subcontractor disputes.
* Strong judgment, organization and follow-up; takes ownership of problems through to resolution.
* Communicates clearly with Ownership, clients, consultants, subcontractors and employees.

**Technology**

* Procore certification is required within your first 60 days. You will become our expert user, because you will enforce Procore across the team.
* Strong with technology in general and quick to learn new software.
* Construction scheduling software (Microsoft Project or comparable); strong Microsoft Excel.
* Experience creating project dashboards and management reports, and reviewing job-costing reports.

**Education and Credentials**

* Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Construction Engineering Technology, Civil Engineering, Architectural Technology or Building Science; or a Red Seal or Certificate of Qualification in a construction trade (such as carpentry) combined with progressive supervisory experience. Equivalent senior-level residential construction experience will also be considered.
* Gold Seal Certification (Project Manager or Superintendent), PMP, P.Eng. or C.E.T. is preferred.
* Ontario Building Code training or BCIN qualification (House or Small Buildings) is an asset.
* Working knowledge of the Ontario Construction Act (holdbacks, liens and prompt payment) and of Tarion and HCRA requirements.
* Current site safety training: Supervisor Health and Safety Awareness, Working at Heights, WHMIS and Standard First Aid, or willingness to complete them before starting.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Ontario G driver's licence. A company vehicle is available at the office for site visits.
* Ability to travel regularly between our Richmond Hill office and project sites across the GTA.
* Willingness to occasionally address urgent project matters outside regular business hours.
* Legally entitled to work in Canada.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You can:

* Write a trade scope that leaves no gaps and no room for extras.
* Recognize when a PM's schedule is unrealistic.
* Identify when materials should already have been ordered.
* Determine whether a delay was unavoidable or caused by poor planning.
* Challenge unsupported subcontractor invoices and extras.
* Recognize missing trade scope and coordination problems.
* Help develop practical recovery plans.
* Step into difficult client or subcontractor situations.
* Identify when projects are quietly moving off schedule, over budget or outside company procedures.

We are a very fast-paced company and we are growing quickly. You are driven, punctual and reliable. You multitask well, stay calm and productive under pressure, and are comfortable when priorities change. You are strong with technology. You want to join a winning team and help take the company to the next level.

You are organized, direct, fair and consistent. High-rise only, civil, industrial or coordinator-level backgrounds are not a fit for this role.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first six to twelve months, you will:

* Have every trade on every project properly scoped and under contract, with compliance documents on file.
* Have every active project on an accurate, current schedule and tracking to its budget.
* Establish consistent accountability across all Project Managers.
* Provide Ownership with reliable weekly project-health reporting.
* Put standardized startup, reporting, change-order and closeout procedures in place.
* Reduce missing documentation, unsupported payments and unauthorized extras.
* Improve communication between PMs, Accounting and Ownership, and improve PM performance and follow-through.
* Build scalable systems that support Plexcon's continued growth.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary of $120,000 a year, plus performance bonuses tied to projects finishing on budget and on schedule. Expected total pay: $120,000 to $150,000 a year.
* Company vehicle available at the office for site visits.
* The senior construction role in a growing builder, working directly with Ownership.
* Real authority over trades, budgets and how projects are run.
* The chance to build the systems and develop the team of Project Managers.
* Room to grow with the company as its portfolio and management team expand.

**To Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short note covering: how many Project Managers or projects you have overseen at once, the type of builder you worked for, and one process you put in place that improved how projects were delivered.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Hiring notices**

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use artificial intelligence tools to help screen applications; a person makes every hiring decision.

We do not require Canadian work experience. Equivalent experience from any country is welcome.

Plexcon Construction Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodation is available on request at every stage of the hiring process, in line with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the AODA.

Applicants who are interviewed will be told the outcome within 45 days of their last interview.

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Description:

**Description**
**About this role:**
In this role you will lead the day to day operations of GBS Outstations as well as focusing on end-to-end transformation, harmonisation and centralisation of finance and back-office processes currently performed across Qatar Airways Outstation network. The role is responsible for driving real, measurable change – embedding strong internal controls, streamlining ways of working, evaluating people and process effectiveness in each outstation, and identifying opportunities to optimise outstation-based activities (finance, accounting, payroll, procurement, vendor management and other back-office tasks). The role partners with stakeholders across finance, the commercial business, GBS, internal audit, tax, procurement, and IT. To design and deliver a leaner, more controlled and more cost-efficient outstation operating model for QR Group.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Global Operations Support Activities**

* Oversee the processing of non-Doha payroll including payroll preparation and security, payroll payment controls, distribution of payroll, statutory payments and numerous types of settlements
* Oversee non-Doha procurement processing including requests for procurement and accounting compliance, handlinf of local payments, manage non-medical insurance policies and be the liaison for asset verification and station taxation with head office teams
* Ensure compliance to group policies and provide Group Legal local level support (legal retainers, POA governance, etc)
* Oversee management of non-Doha facilities including but not limited to lease contracts compliance and driving cost savings where possible.
* Oversee a team supporting QR staff with their duty and staff travel requirements

**Transformation & Process Harmonisation**

* Lead the design and execution of a multi-year programme to harmonise and standardise finance and back-office processes across all QR outstations (finance, accounting, payroll, procurement, vendor management, station admin).
* Map current "as-is" processes per outstation, identify gaps, duplications and weak controls, and define a single "to-be" global process model aligned to QR Group standards.
* Drive embedded internal controls into every redesigned process, ensuring consistency, auditability and full compliance with QR policies and IFRS.
* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, automate and shorten processes using technology, process automation and AI use cases.

**Centralisation & In-Sourcing**

* Identify activities currently performed in outstations (or by third-party providers) that can be centralised into Doha or into the Group's GBS / CDC delivery centres.
* Build the business case for centralisation, covering cost, control, quality, risk and people impact.
* Lead the rationalisation of external vendors providing outsourced finance, payroll, accounting and admin services in outstations, and where appropriate bring those activities in-house under a centralised model.
* Define and run the transition plans (people, process, technology, knowledge transfer, hyper-care and stabilisation).

**Controls, Compliance & Risk**

* Embed a robust internal controls framework in every outstation process, aligned with QR Group's risk and audit standards.
* Ensure full IFRS compliance and consistency of accounting treatments across all outstations.
* Partner with Internal Audit, External Auditors, Tax and Legal to address findings, close gaps and prevent recurrence.
* Maintain documentation, SOPs and control narratives for all redesigned processes.

**People & Effectiveness Reviews**

* Assess the effectiveness and productivity of finance and back-office staff in outstations; identify skill gaps, span-of-control issues and redundancies.
* Recommend organisational changes (re-deployment, up-skilling, role redesign, headcount rationalisation) to support the new centralised model.
* Work closely with HR Business Partners on change management, communication and people transitions across multiple jurisdictions.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the single point of contact for outstation transformation, engaging stakeholders at Corporate (Finance, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, IT, Internal Audit, Legal, HR) and across the commercial business (VPs, Ground Services, Cargo, Sales).
* Influence senior leaders and country teams to adopt standardised processes, often in environments where local autonomy and legacy practices are deeply rooted.
* Build a strong partnering mindset across the organisation to move initiatives over the line.

**Technology & AI Enablement**

* Partner with IT and the Oracle Fusion / ERP transformation team to ensure outstation processes are designed to leverage the Group's target technology stack.
* Identify, pilot and scale AI, process automation, analytics and self-service use cases to streamline outstation processes.

****Management & Leadership****

Title: Food Operations Manager
Description:
**About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

As the Food Operations Manager, you'll be the face of Foodsmart's food operations to our health plan and payer clients, and the person who makes sure members get the right food, on time. You'll report to the Senior Director of Client Operations and help lead the team that runs our food benefit programs end to end.

Foodsmart’s food benefit programs connect clinical nutrition care to real food getting to members’ homes. That means working closely with health plan clients, food vendors, and our clinical teams, with data moving between all of them. You’ll own how that work runs day to day, make sure it works for members and clients, and dig into why when it doesn’t. This role suits someone who is confident with clients, rigorous about root causes, great at organizing complex processes, and comfortable with ambiguity in a growing, evolving program.

### **You will:**

* Design and own the workflows that run food operations, both internally and together with clients: define how food is assessed, approved, and shipped, explain why each step exists and what data we need from the client and what we provide, and secure client buy-in
* Bring internal teams together to follow those workflows consistently, and organize and standardize processes and SOPs across the food operations team
