Title: Director, Software Engineering - CoCounsel Legal
Description:
**Director, Software Engineering - CoCounsel Legal**

**Job Description**

CoCounsel Legal is Thomson Reuters' AI assistant for legal professionals. This role leads the part of it that makes it adaptable: the agent's ability to take on a customer's skills, connect to third-party systems, and remember what matters to each legal team.

As Director, you will lead multiple engineering teams building the core of the CoCounsel Legal product. Your teams will let law firms and corporate legal departments add their own skills, connect their own tools through MCP integrations, and make CoCounsel work the way they do.

You will also contribute directly to the agent itself. This work carries high stakes for confidentiality, permissions, and customer control, and you will make the security and architecture decisions that earn customer trust.

We want an AI-native engineering leader who works at the forefront of AI-assisted development. You already build with coding agents and agent workflows, and you set the standard for how your teams do the same. You stay hands-on, make sound technical trade-offs, and plan strategically while the product and customer needs are still taking shape.

This is a hybrid role based in one of our hub locations: Minneapolis/Eagan, Dallas, Toronto, or New York City. Hybrid means two to three days a week in the office, depending on the role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, and build the leadership layer (managers and technical leads) as the scope grows. Own workforce planning, hiring, performance, calibration, and succession.
* Own the engineering vision and delivery for how customers extend CoCounsel Legal. This includes custom skills and the tools to create, test, version, share, and retire them.
* Lead the design and delivery of MCP and third-party integrations, so customers can connect their own systems and tools to the CoCounsel agent safely and at scale.
* Contribute directly to the CoCounsel agent, working with Agent Core and Science on how it uses skills, tools, memory, and context.
* Own agent memory at the user and organization levels. Start narrow, prove each step with evidence, and expand.
* Make customization safe for the enterprise. Own the security model for sharing and integrations, including least-privilege permissions, audit logging, and administrator controls. Lead the response to complex security and privacy issues, working with Security and Privacy.
* Make evaluation a release gate. Work with Science and subject-matter experts so that skills and agent behavior are tested for quality, accuracy, and fidelity to customer instructions before they ship.
* Set the technical direction. Decide what to build, buy, or partner on, favor reusable primitives over one-off features, and make clear trade-offs among speed, quality, security, and cost.
* Set the standard for AI-native engineering. Define how your teams use coding agents and AI tools to build, review, and verify work, and model that practice yourself.
* Stay hands-on. Spend at least 30% of your time on technical work such as design and code review, prototyping, and building with AI coding agents.
* Build a culture of end-to-end ownership. Your teams design, build, deploy, and operate their services, including on-call, SLOs, and incident response. You take part in the escalation path for major incidents.
* Measure outcomes, not activity. Use DORA metrics alongside quality and developer-experience measures, and fund the next stage of work through short, evidence-based checkpoints.
* Own the investment envelope across people, cloud, AI inference, and vendor services.
* Work directly with customers and Product, including beta customers. Explain engineering trade-offs clearly to business and executive stakeholders.
Partner with peers in Agent Core, Application Experience, Platform, and Corporate Integrations to keep CoCounsel coherent as a product.  

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including proven success leading multiple teams and leading through other managers or technical leads
* Hands-on engineering work within the last two to three years, and the ability to contribute to design, code, and architecture
* Hands-on experience building agentic systems or LLM-based agent features, such as tool use, prompt and instruction management, memory, retrieval, or context management, and a practical sense of where they fail
* AI-native ways of working: daily, proficient use of AI coding tools and agent setups to do engineering work, and experience setting team norms for verifying agent-generated work
* Experience building integrations with third-party systems, and experience with MCP or comparable tool and plugin protocols
* Experience building platforms that customers configure and extend, such as skills, plugins, extension frameworks, or workflow and automation features
* Strong backend foundation, including API design, authentication and authorization, multi-tenancy, versioning, data lifecycle, event-driven processing, and observability
* Experience making sound technical trade-offs and resolving complex security issues, particularly where third-party access and customer data are involved

Title: Senior Manager Logistics
Description:
JOB PURPOSE
  
Responsible for the end-to-end management, operation, and optimization of inbound and outbound logistics for VinFast Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Spare Parts/Accessories across Canada. Ensures all shipments, customs clearances, warehouse operations, and showroom/workshops deliveries are executed safely, accurately, and on schedule at optimal cost, while fully complying with Canadian border regulations (CBSA), CARM frameworks, tax mandates (GST/HST/PST), and corporate quality standards.
  
  
II. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
1. Vehicle Logistics & VDC Operations
  

* Vehicle Import & Distribution:
* Plan and coordinate inbound vehicle shipping from ocean ports/rail terminals to Vehicle Distribution Centers (VDCs) and compounds across Ontario, Quebec, and British Columbia.
* Manage local car-hauler carrier networks and rail transport logistics, ensuring fleet capacity for regional deliveries to VinFast Stores, Service Centers.
* VDC Operations:
* Oversee yard management, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) workflows, detail/wash bays, firmware/OTA software updates, and high voltage and Low Voltage battery charging/maintenance protocols for EV stock.
* Maintain exact real-time inventory records by Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) across SAP ERP and WMS platforms.
* Transit Damage & Claims:
* Coordinate surveys, insurance claims, and transit damage repairs with carriers, 3PL compound operators, and local certified bodyshops.

2. Spare Parts Logistics
  

* Parts Warehouse Operations:
* Direct daily Parts Distribution Center (PDC) operations (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and dispatch), ensuring high Order Fulfillment and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for Canadian Service Centers and collision networks.
* Optimize PDC layout, slotting strategies, picking routes, and HAZMAT handling for EV Lithium-ion battery and other Hazmat parts.
* Inventory Control & Planning:
* Partner with Spare Part department to maintain safety stock levels while mitigating slow moving and obsolete inventory.
* Lead routine cycle counts and annual physical inventory audits, ensuring minimum SAP inventory accuracy of 99.5%.

**Parts Outbound Fulfillment & Service Network Distribution:**  

* Oversee end-to-end outbound logistics and distribution operations for spare parts and accessories from the PDC to VinFast Service Centers, body shops, and authorized 3rd party workshops.
* Manage multi-modal freight transport strategies, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), and dedicated local shuttle routes for routine stock replenishment.
* Direct express delivery services (e.g., FedEx, local couriers) for time-critical and emergency Vehicle Off Road (VOR) parts orders, ensuring strict adherence to repair SLA deadlines.

3. Canadian Customs & Trade Compliance
  

* CBSA & CARM Compliance:
* Oversee Canadian customs compliance, eManifest filings, and import documentation via the CBSA Assessment and Revenue Management (CARM) Client Portal.
* Partner directly with licensed Customs Brokers to ensure accurate HS Code classifications, valuation declarations, and intercompany related-party transfer pricing compliance.
* Tax & Import Regulatory Filings:
* Manage GST/HST and PST tax accounting for imported vehicles and parts in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure compliance with Transport Canada regulations, CMVSS safety standards, and customs liquidation requirements.

4. Vendor Management (3PL) & Cost Optimization
  

* Manage Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers, including port compound operators, car haulers, warehousing contractors, and customs brokers.
* Monitor vendor performance against monthly KPI/SLA metrics (On-Time Delivery, Damage-Free Rate, Order Accuracy).
* Prepare logistics operational budgets, track freight costs, control demurrage/detention charges, and implement cost-reduction initiatives.

5. Systems & Reporting
  

* Utilize SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM), WMS/TMS platforms, and Power BI dashboards to track delivery milestones, inventory aging, and logistics performance.
* Generate regular management reports on On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, stock aging, and logistics cost-per-unit metrics.

III. JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
1. Education & Experience
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, or a related field.
* Experience:
* Minimum 5–7 years of logistics and supply chain experience, with at least 3 years in a management/lead role within the Automotive Industry in Canada.
* Hands-on experience managing both Finished Vehicles (VDC/Car Haulers) and Spare Parts Warehousing (PDC).

2. Technical & Core Competencies
  

* Customs & Compliance: In-depth knowledge of Canadian customs processes, CBSA regulations, CARM portal, eManifest, Incoterms (FOB, CIF, EXW), and GST/HST tax rules.
* ERP & Systems: Proficient in SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM modules), WMS/TMS software, and data tools (Excel / Power BI).
* Vendor & Contract Management: Strong negotiation skills with 3PLs, freight carriers, and warehouse contractors.
* Languages: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Professional working proficiency in French is a strong asset for Quebec market operations.

3. Key Attributes
  

* Strong analytical mindset, highly organized, and thriving in a fast-paced EV growth environment.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills (interacting with Sales, Aftersales Service, Finance, and Legal).
* Flexibility to travel to regional VDCs, PDCs, ocean ports, and retail locations across Canada as needed.

Title: Group Procurement Director
Description:
Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Middle East & Africa is seeking an accomplished **Group Procurement Director** to lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive, group-wide strategic procurement function across our portfolio of operating hotels.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a commercially driven professional capable of transforming a decentralized purchasing environment into a coordinated, efficient, and value-generating procurement organization.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of establishing procurement strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and sourcing capabilities across complex organizations comprising multiple operating entities.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Procurement Strategy & Organization**

* Design and implement a group-wide procurement strategy, operating model, and governance framework.
* Establish procurement policies, procedures, approval authorities, and compliance standards across the hotel portfolio.
* Define the optimal balance between centralized strategic sourcing and decentralized operational purchasing.

**2. Group Synergies & Value Creation**

* Identify and capture procurement synergies, economies of scale, and consolidation opportunities across multiple properties and geographies.
* Develop category management strategies, group purchasing agreements, and preferred supplier frameworks.
* Deliver measurable cost efficiencies while maintaining operational quality, service standards, and business continuity.

**3. Supplier & Contract Management**

* Lead strategic supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and performance management.
* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and develop regional and international sourcing opportunities.
* Implement robust supplier evaluation, risk management, and contractual governance processes.

**4. Performance, Technology & Transformation**

* Introduce procurement performance indicators, spend analytics, reporting dashboards, and savings measurement methodologies.
* Drive procurement digitalization, including appropriate e-procurement platforms and purchasing systems.
* Build a culture of procurement excellence, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**

* Partner closely with hotel General Managers, Finance Directors, operational teams, and corporate leadership.
* Engage constructively with hotel owners and stakeholders to align procurement initiatives with property-level requirements and ownership structures.
* Build and lead a high-performing procurement organization capable of supporting a geographically diversified portfolio.

**The ideal candidate:**

* 15+ years of professional experience, including significant leadership responsibilities in strategic procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management.
* Demonstrated success in designing, establishing, and scaling centralized or coordinated procurement functions across large, decentralized, multi-entity organizations.
* Strong experience in category management, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, procurement governance, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to generate measurable financial benefits through procurement consolidation and organizational transformation.
* Experience in hospitality, retail, food & beverage, travel retail, or other multi-site service industries. Hospitality experience is advantageous but not essential.
* Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, analytical capabilities, and technology orientation.
* Excellent leadership, influencing, and change-management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across independently managed operating entities.
* Preferably currently based in the UAE or wider GCC, with relevant regional market knowledge and supplier networks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualifications or professional certifications are advantageous.

**Why join us?**

This position offers the opportunity to **build and shape a strategic procurement function at group level**, with direct influence on operational performance, profitability, and long-term value creation.

Reporting to the Chief Performance Officer, the Group Procurement Director will play a central role in strengthening the operational excellence and competitiveness of Millennium & Copthorne Hotels across the Middle East and Africa.

We welcome applications from accomplished procurement leaders across industries who have demonstrated the ability to create scalable, high-performing procurement organizations.

**If you have built procurement capabilities across complex, multi-site businesses and are ready to make a tangible impact at regional level, we would welcome your interest.**

Global Travel Retail Executive
Description:
**Job Description: Global Travel Retail (GTR) Executive**

**Company:** Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI)  
**Department:** Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE – Head Office  
**Reporting to:** Director – Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirements:** Based on business needs.

**Position Overview:**

Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI) is seeking a proactive, commercially driven Travel Retail Executive to support the continued expansion and management of its Global Travel Retail business.

With a rapidly growing presence across international airports and partnerships with leading duty-free operators, the successful candidate will play a central role in managing day-to-day commercial activities, coordinating with retail partners, and ensuring the effective execution of GTI's commercial and marketing initiatives across the channel.

The position requires strong account management, analytical, and coordination capabilities, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and projects across different markets.

The Travel Retail Executive will serve as the primary operational point of contact between GTI, its duty-free partners, and internal departments, ensuring commercial plans are translated into measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Travel Retail Account Management:**

* Manage day-to-day commercial relationships and operational communication with existing duty-free operators.
* Act as the main coordination point for account-related inquiries, operational requirements, and commercial follow-ups.
* Maintain regular communication with duty-free operators to review sales performance, stock availability, product assortment, and ongoing commercial activities.
* Monitor the implementation of agreed commercial terms, including pricing, margins, listing fees, promotional commitments, and payment conditions.
* Maintain an updated database of accounts, airports, retail locations, contacts, commercial agreements, and key account requirements.
* Support management in preparing business reviews and identifying opportunities to improve account performance.

**Sales Performance, Reporting & Analysis:**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyse periodic sales reports from duty-free operators, with visibility by airport, terminal, shop, brand, and SKU wherever available.
* Develop and maintain monthly sales dashboards tracking actual performance against forecasts and targets.
* Identify sales trends, underperforming SKUs, and opportunities to improve product assortment and retail performance.
* Monitor retail selling prices, competitive positioning, and relevant market developments across airports.
* Coordinate with retail partners to establish consistent sales reporting schedules and ensure timely receipt of accurate data.
* Prepare monthly account performance reviews with key findings, recommendations, and follow-up actions.

**Planning, Inventory & Order Management:**

* Coordinate with duty-free operators to obtain regular stock reports and monitor inventory levels by SKU and retail location.
* Work closely with GTI's Demand Planning, Production, and Logistics teams to develop rolling sales forecasts and replenishment requirements.
* Proactively identify potential out-of-stock situations and recommend timely replenishment orders.
* Coordinate purchase orders from confirmation through production, shipment, delivery, and receipt.
* Monitor stock coverage, inventory ageing, and slow-moving products, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Maintain visibility over lead times, shipment schedules, and operational constraints affecting product availability.

**New Listings & Business Expansion:**

* Support the onboarding of new duty-free accounts and airport listings with international operators, including Avolta, Heinemann, OSPREE, CREOL, and other partners.
* Coordinate the administrative and operational requirements for new product listings, including SKU documentation, product specifications, pricing submissions, and required commercial information.
* Maintain a central pipeline tracker for upcoming airport listings, launches, and account development projects.
* Coordinate internally with Marketing, Finance, Legal, Production, and Logistics to ensure timely completion of listing requirements.
* Follow up with partners on launch schedules, initial purchase orders, stock delivery, and retail readiness.
* Support the preparation of commercial presentations, account proposals, and business development materials.

**Marketing & Retail Execution:**

* Coordinate with GTI's Marketing team and duty-free operators to implement agreed trade marketing activities, promotional campaigns, and brand visibility initiatives.
* Monitor the installation and maintenance of branded displays, gondolas, point-of-sale materials (POSM), and other merchandising assets.
* Ensure the agreed product assortment, shelf placement, and brand visibility standards are maintained across retail locations.
* Coordinate promotional calendars, in-store activations, and seasonal commercial initiatives with retail partners.
* Monitor the execution of marketing commitments, including display rentals, promotional placements, and other agreed investments.
* Gather photographic evidence, retail feedback, and execution reports to assess the effectiveness of marketing activities.

**Brand Ambassador & Agency Coordination:**

* Coordinate with appointed Brand Ambassador and merchandising agencies supporting GTI's Travel Retail operations.
* Monitor staffing deployment, attendance, retail coverage, and compliance with agreed service requirements.
* Collect and review Brand Ambassador sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate product training, promotional briefs, and brand-related communication in collaboration with Marketing.
* Track agency performance against agreed KPIs and escalate execution gaps where necessary.
* Support the evaluation of promotional activities and Brand Ambassador effectiveness in driving incremental sales.

**Commercial Administration & Financial Coordination:**

* Maintain accurate records of commercial agreements, pricing structures, listing fees, promotional budgets, and account-specific financial commitments.
* Coordinate with Finance on sales reconciliations, invoicing, payment follow-ups, and outstanding receivables.
* Support monthly reconciliation of consignment sales and inventory for accounts operating under consignment arrangements.
* Validate reported sales quantities, applicable commercial deductions, marketing fees, and settlement amounts against agreed commercial terms.
* Track approved trade marketing expenditure and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Highlight commercial discrepancies, unapproved changes, or potential financial exposure to management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

Performance will be assessed against a combination of commercial, operational, and execution-related indicators:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and growth across assigned Travel Retail accounts.
* **Product Availability:** Stock availability, stock coverage, and reduction of avoidable out-of-stock incidents.
* **Forecast Accuracy:** Reliability of sales forecasts and replenishment recommendations.
* **Reporting Discipline:** Timely submission and accuracy of sales, stock, and account performance reports.
* **Listing Execution:** Timely completion of new airport listings, product launches, and associated operational milestones.
* **Retail Execution:** Compliance with agreed assortment, merchandising, display, and promotional requirements.
* **Agency Performance:** Brand Ambassador coverage, reporting compliance, and achievement of agreed performance objectives.
* **Financial Follow-Up:** Timely sales reconciliation, invoicing coordination, and resolution of outstanding payment issues.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, or a related field.

**Professional Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, previous experience in Travel Retail, Duty Free, FMCG, or consumer goods distribution is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with international retail operators, distributors, or multi-market accounts would be an advantage.
* Practical exposure to sales forecasting, inventory management, order processing, and commercial reporting.
* Experience coordinating promotional activities, merchandising programs, or third-party agencies is desirable.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookups, and sales analysis.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint and preparation of commercial presentations.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, order management processes, and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Power BI or other business intelligence tools would be an advantage.
* Good understanding of commercial pricing, retail margins, inventory management, and sales performance indicators.

**Core Competencies:**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Ability to interpret sales data, understand retail dynamics, and identify business opportunities.
* **Account Management:** Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build effective relationships with international partners.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Comfortable working with numbers, identifying trends, and translating data into actionable recommendations.
* **Planning & Organization:** Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and concurrent projects.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Effective coordination with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Demand Planning, and Logistics.
* **Problem-Solving:** Proactive approach to resolving operational issues and escalating risks.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multicultural, and expanding international business environment.

Title: Retail Operations Leader
Description:
**Your Style, Your Career**

Harry Rosen is a proudly Canadian born and raised retailer of fine quality menswear with store locations across the nation. We have been specializing in luxury menswear for over 70 years and have been officially recognized as one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies. We are committed to developing retail professionals who love retail and have the passion and ability to inspire exceptional service.

  

**Retail Operations Leader**

*Full-Time Permanent*

*Reporting to: Retail Experience and Enablement Leader*

*Toronto, Ontario – Harry Rosen Inc. Central Office (77 Bloor St. West)*

*Hybrid work environment (Remote/Central Office) – approximately 50% of time in stores; regular travel to chain and outlet locations across Canada required*

The Retail Operations Leader sets and upholds national operating standards across our regular and outlet stores. Reporting to the Retail Experience and Enablement Leader, this role owns store SOPs and readiness, leads compliance reviews and audit follow-up, drives Tailorshop productivity and quality, and provides oversight of the service desk and store support functions. This is a field-facing role: approximately 50% of your time will be spent in stores, reviewing operations and supporting leaders in person, so regular travel across our national store network is required. The Retail Operations Leader is the first escalation point for store operations leaders and ensures every store works from one clear set of operating instructions.

**Responsibilities in this role:**
----------------------------------

**Set Standards and Readiness**

* Write and maintain SOPs for service desk, POS, returns, client files, Tailorshop and BOPIS; approve changes within national policy and submit new standards for approval.
* Release each SOP change to stores with a summary of what changed and the effective date, and review each SOP annually and after any audit finding.
* Build readiness checklists for peak periods, promotional events and inventory counts, and track store sign-off to confirm completion before each date.

**Drive Store Compliance**

* Spend up to 50% of your time in stores, visiting every regular and outlet location at least once per year.
* Set a compliance review schedule covering every store and complete reviews in store or remotely, checking service desk, POS, returns and client files against SOPs.
* Score each review, report results by store to the respective DVP, and log each corrective action with an owner and date, following up until closed.

**Lead Tailorshop Productivity**

* Write Tailorshop operating standards for intake and associated procedures, and own the Tailorshop tool for measuring productivity and quality.
* Report turnaround and quality by store monthly; escalate stores below standard to their DVP, investigate causes and propose solutions (e.g. outsourcing, productivity by tailor).
* Develop capacity planning strategies to manage peak demand while maintaining quality standards.
* Partner with Operations Leaders on best practices, training gaps and financial efficiency, and oversee technology and equipment upgrades.

**Own Governance and Loss Prevention Follow-Up**

* Update store LP protocols with the LP team when policy changes or an audit shows a gap, and build them into SOPs and compliance reviews.
* Lead follow-up after each LP audit: confirm findings with the store, set corrective actions and track them to close.
* Investigate inventory count variances with LP and the Director of Logistics, Store Network, and report causes and fixes.

**Enable Store Operations Leaders**

* Support onboarding of each new operations leader: share current SOPs, the compliance schedule and open audit actions, walk through their store’s results, and check in at 30, 60 and 90 days.
* Act as the first escalation point for SOP and procedure questions, updating SOPs when the same question recurs.
* Align with the Director of Logistics, Store Network before any operations change affecting store logistics roles, so stores receive one set of instructions.

**Lead Operations Communication**

* Run the weekly operations call: set the agenda, cover SOP changes, readiness dates and open audit actions, and publish actions after the call.
* Log store requests to central office teams, route each to an owner and track it to close.
* Oversee that the IT roadmap for operations-related store technology stays on track with updates, enhancements and timelines.

**Lead the Service Desk**

* Provide oversight for the service desk and store support functions, driving operational efficiencies across the chain.
* Establish service standards and processes that support elevated customer experiences and NPS objectives.
* Develop cross-functional workforce strategies to increase role versatility and optimize resources.
* Ensure compliance with chain-wide POS policies and lead inventory management initiatives that improve speed and accuracy.

**The successful candidate will bring the following:**
------------------------------------------------------

* **5+ years of retail operations leadership experience**, ideally in luxury or specialty retail, including supporting or leading operations across multiple locations
* A proven track record of writing, rolling out and maintaining SOPs, and driving consistent compliance through audits, scoring and corrective action follow-up
* Strong working knowledge of store operations, including POS, returns, service desk, client files, BOPIS and inventory counts
* Experience with tailoring or alterations operations, including productivity, turnaround, quality measurement and capacity planning, is a strong asset
* Experience partnering with Loss Prevention and Logistics to investigate shrink and inventory variances and close audit findings
* A track record of onboarding, supporting and coaching store operations leaders, acting as a trusted escalation point
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to turn store-level data into clear actions
* Highly organized, with excellent project management, communication and facilitation skills, including leading national calls and tracking requests to close
* Comfort with retail technology and experience supporting technology or equipment rollouts
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 50% of time spent in regular and outlet stores across Canada
* A welcoming and inclusive mindset, and a passion for emulating and upholding our core values

**What are the perks of the job?**
----------------------------------

  

* Opportunities to additionally earn monthly and annual Team bonuses
* Best in industry discounts and special purchase opportunities
* A comprehensive flexible benefits package
* Pension and Group RRSP Programs that grow with you
* A modern, digitally advanced workplace
* A coach committed to supporting the achievement of your personal career goals
* A culture that is rich and diverse fostered through an internal Diversity Equity and Inclusion Council
* An employer that values internal growth and promotion and is committed to succession planning for your future

**Compensation for this role will depend on skills and experiences, and will range from $80,000 - $100,000 base annually, plus bonus.**

Title: Flight Safety Manager
Description:
**Job Description:**

**This Is How We Fly**
----------------------

At JSX, we’re not just a lifestyle carrier – we’re a lifestyle employer. Here, entrepreneurship meets determination, and excellence is our standard. We believe that the journey is just as important as the destination, and every day, we strive to create a Joyful, Simple eXperience for our Customers. Join us, and find your runway to growth, innovation, and success.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

The Flight Safety Manager is responsible for developing, administering, and continuously improving JSX's flight safety initiatives, with a focus on identifying, evaluating, and mitigating risks associated with flight operations.

  

In this role, you'll oversee the Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA) program, using flight data to identify operational trends, emerging hazards, and opportunities to strengthen safety performance. You'll translate complex information into actionable recommendations that support risk-informed decisions and proactive operational improvements.

  

You'll also manage flight irregularity reporting, maintain safety databases, participate in incident investigations, and prepare reports and presentations that provide visibility into flight safety performance. Working closely with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other departments, you'll help ensure safety concerns are appropriately evaluated and addressed.

  

As a key connection between flight operations and JSX's Safety Management System (SMS), you'll support the consistent application of established safety processes, promote meaningful operational engagement, and help foster a culture of proactive risk identification and continuous improvement.

  

This is an opportunity for an aviation safety professional who combines analytical thinking, operational knowledge, and sound judgment with a commitment to protecting people and strengthening aviation safety.

  

**A Day in the Life**
---------------------

In this role, you'll:

  

**Flight Safety Program Management**

* Develop, administer, and continuously improve flight safety initiatives that support safe and reliable operations.
* Manage the Flight Irregularities Program, including coordinating follow-up communications with Flight Crewmembers after reported events or incidents.
* Review Pilot Debriefs and other operational reports to identify safety concerns, emerging trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare and distribute preliminary event reports to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate and organized Flight Safety and Flight Mechanical databases.
* Evaluate existing safety programs, policies, and procedures to identify opportunities for improved effectiveness.
Support the implementation of safety recommendations and monitor progress toward established objectives.  

  

**Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA)**

* Oversee the administration, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of JSX's FOQA program.
* Analyze flight operational data to identify trends, potential hazards, and areas of increased operational risk.
* Review FOQA findings and translate data-driven insights into practical safety recommendations.
* Coordinate FOQA-related communications and collaborate with operational stakeholders to support program objectives.
* Partner with Flight Operations, Training, and Maintenance to evaluate findings and identify opportunities for risk reduction.
* Support the integration of FOQA insights into broader safety initiatives and established SMS processes.
Monitor recurring operational trends and recommend proactive measures to improve flight safety performance.  

  

**Safety Investigations & Risk Management**

* Participate in investigations of aviation safety events and incidents reported by Crewmembers.
* Conduct root cause analyses to identify contributing factors and recommend appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* Evaluate safety-related information to identify operational hazards and potential areas of risk.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to assess findings and develop practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Support the documentation, communication, and evaluation of flight operational risks through JSX's Safety Management System.
* Assist with Emergency Response activities and other assigned safety programs.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying lessons learned from safety events, investigations, and operational data.  

  

**Safety Reporting & Data Analysis**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and annual flight safety reports, analyses, and program summaries.
* Develop presentations and supporting materials for safety working groups, operational stakeholders, and leadership.
* Analyze safety program data, operational trends, and relevant policies to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain accurate and timely safety records, databases, and supporting documentation.
* Translate technical and operational findings into clear, actionable information for stakeholders.
* Monitor safety performance indicators and communicate emerging concerns through appropriate channels.
Support data-driven decision-making by providing meaningful insights into flight safety performance.  

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Safety Culture**

* Partner with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other departments to strengthen the effectiveness of flight safety initiatives.
* Conduct Safety Department briefings for Flight Crewmembers to communicate relevant safety information, program updates, and operational concerns.
* Engage with operational teams to promote awareness of safety risks, reporting expectations, and established procedures.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to support consistent execution of safety recommendations and corrective actions.
* Encourage proactive hazard identification, open communication, and continuous improvement.
* Support departmental initiatives and special projects as directed by the Director of Safety.
Travel to JSX locations or other operational sites as needed to support safety programs, investigations, and related activities.  

  

**Why You'll Love This Role**
-----------------------------

* **Make a Meaningful Safety Impact:** Help identify and mitigate operational risks that directly influence the safety of JSX Customers, Crewmembers, and aircraft.
* **Lead Data-Driven Safety Initiatives:** Oversee the FOQA program and use flight data to uncover trends, identify hazards, and support proactive improvements.
* **Collaborate Across Aviation:** Work closely with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other stakeholders to strengthen operational safety.
* **Turn Insights Into Action:** Use safety investigations, root cause analysis, and performance reporting to recommend meaningful improvements.
* **Influence Safety Culture:** Help promote proactive reporting, operational engagement, and a shared commitment to continuous improvement.
* **Expand Your Aviation Safety Expertise:** Gain exposure to flight safety programs, SMS processes, operational investigations, and safety data analysis.

  

**What Makes a Successful Flight Safety Manager?**
--------------------------------------------------

We're looking for someone who is:

  

* **Safety-Focused:** You maintain an unwavering commitment to aviation safety, regulatory compliance, and proactive risk management.
* **Analytical:** You can interpret complex operational data, identify trends, and develop meaningful recommendations based on your findings.
* **Detail-Oriented:** You understand the importance of accurate safety records, thorough investigations, and reliable reporting.
* **Proactive:** You anticipate potential risks, recognize emerging hazards, and take initiative to address concerns before they become larger issues.
* **Collaborative:** You build strong relationships across departments and work effectively with operational teams to support shared safety objectives.
* **Communicative:** You translate technical information into clear, practical insights and communicate effectively with Flight Crewmembers and leadership.
* **Objective:** You approach safety investigations and operational evaluations with sound judgment, professionalism, and a commitment to understanding contributing factors.
* **Organized:** You manage multiple safety initiatives, maintain accurate documentation, and consistently follow through on assigned responsibilities.
* **Adaptable:** You remain composed and effective when responding to operational events, changing priorities, and unexpected challenges.
* **Entrepreneurial:** You challenge existing processes constructively, embrace innovative approaches, and seek opportunities to strengthen safety performance and operational excellence.

  

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* Minimum of two years of aviation experience.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Safety, Aviation, Engineering Sciences, Physical Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* FAA Airman Certificate.
* Good understanding of Federal Aviation Regulations and applicable FAA and National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) requirements.
* Knowledge of aviation accident and incident investigation processes.
* Understanding of pilot, maintenance, and cabin safety, including human factors and system safety principles.
* Ability to evaluate operational risks, analyze safety-related information, and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify trends and evaluate contributing factors.
* Ability to conduct root cause analyses and support safety investigations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare reports, deliver briefings, and communicate technical information effectively.
* Fluency in reading, writing, and speaking English.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when maintaining safety records, databases, and reports.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other operational stakeholders.
* Sound judgment and ability to handle sensitive safety information professionally.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and respond effectively to operational needs.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% of the time.  

  

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Previous experience in commercial aviation operations.
* Experience administering, supporting, or analyzing a Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA) program.
* Familiarity with aviation Safety Management Systems (SMS) and operational risk management practices.
* Experience analyzing flight operational data, identifying safety trends, or developing safety performance reports.
* Previous involvement in aviation safety investigations, incident reviews, or root cause analysis.
* Experience working with flight safety databases or aviation safety reporting systems.
* Experience conducting safety briefings or presenting operational findings to aviation stakeholders.
Familiarity with cross-functional safety initiatives involving Flight Operations, Training, or Maintenance.  

  

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* **Health Benefits:** New Crewmembers become eligible for coverage on the 1st of the month following the start date, with medical plans beginning at just $110/month. 100% employer-paid dental & vision, plus up to $2,100 annually for HSA contribution. Short-term and long-term disability coverage at no cost.
* **Travel Benefits:** Enjoy free non-revenue standby travel on JSX, plus deeply discounted standby travel on other major domestic and international airlines for you and your qualifying immediate family.
* **401(k) Match:** 50% of your first 8%.
* **Generous PTO:** Take time to recharge with our flexible PTO plan.

  

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

May perform other responsibilities as assigned. Responsibilities and duties may change when circumstances dictate, including emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs, technical developments, or evolving business needs.

Ready to soar with us? Join JSX, where every day is a chance to be part of something eXtraordinary!

**Partners to Collaborate With and Support**

* **Practice Leads (Adobe, Shopify, Odoo, Custom Dev, Cloud, AI):** Partner on solutioning, proposals, and credentials marshalling.

* **Marketing, Alliances & Operations:** Co-create regional campaigns, partner co-marketing, ABM programs, forecasting hygiene, and contract governance.

* **Pipeline Health:** Sustained 3–4x quota coverage with healthy distribution across funnel stages and source channels.
* **Partner-Sourced Wins:** Demonstrable contribution from Adobe, Shopify, Odoo, and other partners — measured by sourced pipeline, joint pursuits, and referrals.
* **Strategic Logo Acquisition:** Acquisition of named target logos in priority verticals, with traceable path from first conversation to signed engagement.
* **Forecasting Accuracy & Account Expansion:** Forecast variance within agreed tolerance; clean CRM hygiene; repeat business and account expansion within 12 months of go-live.

**Core Competencies**

* **Consultative Enterprise Selling:** Shape services engagements that deliver measurable business outcomes — not just sell hours or scope.
* **Regional Market Fluency:** Deep understanding of UAE and GCC business culture, decision-making, procurement, family-business dynamics, and the rhythm of government-led programs.
* **Partner Ecosystem Development:** Established relationships with platform partner sales teams in the region, with a track record of unlocking co-sell motion that delivers revenue, not just meetings.
* **Enterprise Deal Leadership:** Lead complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from discovery to close, navigating procurement, legal, and security review processes.
* **Commercial Discipline & Executive Presence:** Structure financially sound deals; maintain accurate forecasts; carry the gravitas to engage C-suite and Board-level stakeholders.

**Professional Experience**

* 10 + years selling digital consulting, implementation services, or enterprise technology, with the majority of recent experience in the Middle East. Currently based in Dubai.
* Demonstrable track record of personally closing services engagements at significant ACV and carrying / delivering annual quotas at an enterprise scale.
* Experience selling implementation services tied to Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, Adobe Commerce, Analytics, Target), Shopify Plus, Odoo ERP.

* Experience selling into one or more priority verticals: retail and eCommerce, real estate, logistics, healthcare, manufacturing, or government / public sector. Comfort working with India-based delivery teams.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification preferred. Arabic language ability is a strong plus, not a requirement.

**Expectations for the Role**

* Communicate clearly across written, verbal, and virtual settings — internally with India delivery teams and externally with clients and partners.
* Manage multiple opportunities and stakeholders with strong personal accountability and forecast discipline.
* Operate effectively across UAE, India, and US time zones in a distributed environment.

Pay: AED18,000.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Title: B2B Sales Manager, KSA
Description:
**About the Company**

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

### **About the Role**

As B2B Sales Manager, KSA, you will own Flow's corporate housing and relocation business across the Kingdom. You will be the senior commercial relationship for HR leaders, global mobility teams, and procurement at the largest employers in Saudi Arabia — from giga-projects and government-linked entities to multinationals, consulting firms, and fast-scaling local champions bringing talent into the country. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hunter-closer who can open doors at the executive level, structure multi-unit, multi-year agreements, and translate Flow's living experience into a compelling solution for companies relocating and housing their people. You will carry a personal quota, work an enterprise-style pipeline, and act as the voice of the corporate customer inside Flow.

### **Responsibilities**

**Pipeline & New Business Development:**

* Identify, prioritize, and pursue target accounts across KSA — including giga-projects, government and semi-government entities, multinationals, consulting and professional services firms, and fast-growing local employers with significant mobility needs.
* Build and own a robust pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry events, networking, partnerships with relocation management companies (RMCs), and referrals.
* Lead full cycle sales: discovery, solution design, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation, and contract close.

**Account Management & Renewals:**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for corporate accounts post-signature, ensuring smooth onboarding and a seamless resident experience for relocated employees.
* Drive renewals, expansions, and cross-sell across Flow's MENA footprint as new communities come online.
* Build deep, trust-based relationships with HR, global mobility, procurement, and executive sponsors at key accounts.

**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring:**

* Structure multi-unit, multi-year corporate housing agreements that balance occupancy, ADR, and long-term account value.
* Partner with finance and revenue management to price competitively while protecting margin.
* Work with legal on master service agreements, preferred supplier arrangements, and bespoke contract terms required by enterprise customers.

**Cross-Functional Partnership:**

* Partner with property leadership and operations to ensure corporate residents receive the experience promised in the sales process.
* Work closely with Marketing on B2B campaigns, account-based marketing, sector positioning, and industry events.
* Provide structured feedback to product, operations, and leadership on what enterprise customers need from Flow's offering in KSA.

**Market Intelligence:**

* Maintain a clear view of the KSA corporate housing landscape — competitor offerings, pricing, inventory, and how mobility budgets are evolving as Vision 2030 reshapes the market.
* Track demand drivers across sectors and translate them into a focused account plan.

  

### **Ideal Background**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, with a meaningful portion selling into HR, global mobility, procurement, or C-suite buyers at large enterprises.
* Direct experience in corporate housing, serviced apartments, extended-stay hospitality, relocation services, or commercial/residential real estate selling to corporate accounts. Adjacent enterprise sales backgrounds will be considered for the right profile.
* Deep, current network across KSA — HR and mobility leaders, RMCs, giga-project employers, and major multinationals operating in the Kingdom.
* Proven track record carrying and exceeding individual quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
* Strong commercial instincts: comfortable structuring multi-unit agreements, negotiating MSAs, and defending pricing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; Arabic fluency is strongly preferred and a meaningful advantage for this role.
* Familiarity with the KSA regulatory and business environment, including Saudization, Iqama, and the dynamics of doing business with government-linked entities.
* A builder's mindset — comfortable operating without a fully built playbook in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Why Join Flow?**

  

Headquartered in the United States, Flow was established in 2021 with a $350 million investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the largest individual investment in the venture capital firm's history.

Since entering the MENA region in 2024 via the acquisition of close to one thousand units in Saudi Arabia, the company has become one of the largest owners and operators of residential real estate in the Kingdom.

Joining the company now would mean stepping into a pivotal role at a transformational time. You’ll work alongside a high-caliber team to launch flagship communities, deliver iconic resident experiences, and redefine what it means to call the region home.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Deputy Head of After-Sales

Title: Membership Sales Manager - Recreation
Description:
About Us

As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests a personal and enriching experience.

If you'd like to embrace a wider world of experiences and opportunities, we'd like to welcome you to the world's most international luxury hotel brand.

Located on Doha's longest private beach and nestled in landscaped gardens, the InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa features 12 restaurants, a range of recreational facilities, a free-form swimming pool, and the world-class Spa InterContinental.

Situated in an exclusive location, minutes from downtown Doha and major government and corporate offices and within minutes to the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall, and Doha Golf Club, our properties offer distinctive surroundings which will forever redefine luxury.

Your Day to Day

As the Membership Sales Manager, you will be responsible for leading and driving the membership sales strategy within the Recreation Department, focusing on maximizing membership revenue, expanding our membership base, and strengthening long-term relationships with existing members.

Working closely with the Recreation team and other hotel departments, you will identify new business opportunities, develop effective sales initiatives, and ensure that our membership offerings remain competitive and aligned with the hotel's luxury positioning.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, strategic sales capabilities, relationship management skills, and a genuine passion for luxury hospitality to drive business growth while delivering exceptional member experiences.

Key Responsibilities Include:

* Develop and implement effective membership sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, increase membership acquisition, and maximize retention.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, networking, referrals, and corporate partnerships.
* Lead the membership sales process, from initial inquiries and facility tours to negotiations, conversions, and membership renewals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective members, ensuring personalized service and long-term loyalty.
* Develop and execute targeted sales campaigns, promotional initiatives, and membership packages to attract new members and drive revenue growth.
* Identify opportunities to expand corporate memberships, group packages, and strategic partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor membership sales performance, conversion rates, renewals, and retention trends, implementing corrective actions where necessary.
* Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends, pricing opportunities, and areas for business development.
* Collaborate with the Recreation, Marketing, and other operational teams to develop promotional activities and enhance membership visibility.
* Oversee the membership renewal process, proactively engaging with members to maximize retention and identify upselling opportunities.
* Ensure all prospective members receive professional facility tours that effectively communicate the unique benefits and experiences offered by the hotel.
* Handle member feedback and concerns professionally, ensuring timely resolution and maintaining high levels of satisfaction.
* Prepare regular sales forecasts, performance reports, and membership growth analyses for management review.
* Establish and maintain an accurate database of prospective and existing members, ensuring effective follow-up and relationship management.
* Identify opportunities to enhance membership offerings, benefits, and experiences based on member feedback and market demand.
* Support the development of the annual membership sales budget and revenue objectives.
* Ensure all membership sales activities comply with hotel policies, brand standards, and established operational procedures.
* Lead, coach, and support the membership sales team, where applicable, to achieve individual and departmental objectives.
* Foster a proactive, results-driven sales culture while maintaining the highest standards of luxury service and professionalism.

What We Need From You

Ideally, you'll have some or all of the following competencies and experience we're looking for:

* Proven experience in a Membership Sales Manager, Sales Manager, or similar commercial role, preferably within hotel recreation, leisure facilities, fitness clubs, or luxury hospitality, with a strong understanding of recreation operations, membership management, and guest engagement.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute successful sales strategies, achieve revenue targets, and drive membership growth.
* Strong understanding of membership acquisition, retention, renewals, and relationship management.
* Established networking and business development capabilities, with the ability to identify and secure new corporate and individual membership opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to analyze sales performance, market trends, and revenue opportunities.
* Proven ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with high-value clients and members.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* A proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Experience developing sales promotions, membership packages, and strategic partnerships.
* Strong understanding of luxury service standards and a commitment to delivering exceptional member experiences.
* Knowledge of the local market and an established professional network in Qatar would be an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant CRM or membership management systems.
* Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings and weekends, as required by business needs.

What We Offer

We’ll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.

Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.

So go on - show us how your passion and personality are the perfect fit to deliver memorable experiences to our guests.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Title: Sales Manager, GCC & ME (Arabic Speaker)
Description:
Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai is looking for a Sales Manager – GCC & Middle East to join our Sales team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

With a pristine oceanfront setting, Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai is a stylish urban resort overlooking the clear blue waters of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s glittering skyline, which is dominated by Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. The hotel's beachfront location and open-air facilities are designed to bring a new level of relaxed luxury to the city.

**About the job**

The Sales Manager is responsible for the commercial performance and development of an assigned territory and portfolio of accounts. The role develops and implements territory and account plans, acquires new business, strengthens existing client relationships and delivers agreed revenue and production targets.

The Sales Manager takes ownership of the assigned portfolio, using market intelligence and account performance analysis to identify opportunities, establish priorities and recommend appropriate commercial actions. The role operates with a high degree of independence within the hotel's agreed commercial strategy and pricing guidelines, reporting directly to the Director of Sales.

**As Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

  

**Territory and Portfolio Ownership**

* Take ownership of the assigned territory and portfolio, ensuring effective coverage of relevant corporate, government, MICE, leisure and business travel agent accounts.

* Develop and maintain a territory business plan and account plans aligned with the hotel's commercial strategy and business mix objectives.

* Establish account priorities based on revenue potential, production, profitability and strategic importance.

* Acquire, develop and retain key accounts, identifying opportunities to increase market share and account contribution.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and key stakeholders within assigned accounts.

* Ensure effective coverage of all relevant revenue opportunities within the portfolio.

  
  

**Business Development and Commercial Performance**

* Proactively identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within the assigned territory.

* Lead account negotiations and prepare commercial proposals within approved pricing and business parameters.

* Manage RFP participation and develop account strategies to maximise acceptance and conversion.

* Identify opportunities to increase revenue through account development, upselling, cross-selling and improved business mix.

* Monitor account production and pipeline performance, taking corrective action where required.

* Recommend tactics and strategies to improve revenue performance, address shortfalls and maximise business opportunities.

* Ensure that sales activities and account plans are translated into measurable commercial results.

  
  

**Market Intelligence and Strategic Planning**

* Analyse market conditions, competitor activity, economic trends, supply and demand, customer behaviour and emerging business opportunities.

* Identify changes in market dynamics that may affect the hotel's performance and recommend appropriate responses.

* Provide accurate and timely reporting on territory, segment and account production.

* Use market and account intelligence to inform territory plans, account priorities and sales activity.

* Represent the hotel at trade shows, sales missions, industry events and relevant client functions.

* Contribute informed recommendations to the Director of Sales on territory opportunities, business risks and commercial priorities.

  
  

**Client Relationship Management and Service Delivery**

* Ensure that client requests, proposals and business commitments are managed professionally and within agreed timeframes.

* Work closely with Reservations, Front Office, Conference & Events and other hotel departments to ensure effective delivery of account requirements.

* Resolve account-related issues and escalate matters requiring senior management involvement.

* Promote customer loyalty and uphold Mandarin Oriental brand standards through consistent service excellence.

* Maximise opportunities to cross-sell the Mandarin Oriental portfolio through the MObilise programme.

  
  

**Collaboration and Departmental Contribution**

* Share market knowledge, account intelligence and best practices with colleagues in the Sales department.

* Collaborate with the wider Sales team to ensure consistent market coverage and avoid duplication of client activity.

* Attend departmental meetings and contribute meaningful account, market and performance updates.

Title: Senior Manager, MX B2B Sales Operations (Onsite - Plano, TX)
Description:
**Position Summary**

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
  
  
Headquartered in Plano, TX, Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.
  
  
For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.
  
  
As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.
  
  
To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**ABOUT MX (Mobile Experience) B2B**

Samsung's MX B2B division drives mobile sales to business customers across the full spectrum of go-to-market channels: Distribution Channel, Carrier, SMB, and eCommerce. Our product portfolio spans the full Samsung mobile ecosystem, with core lines including smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, and laptops. We partner with enterprise resellers, national carriers, and direct business customers to bring Samsung's device portfolio to organizations of all sizes. Our sales operations function keeps that engine running.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior Manager, MX B2B Sales Operations to lead the management plan (MP) breakdown and management by objectives (MBO) processes for MX B2B, own CBS pipeline performance and governance, and lead the team that delivers sell-through, sell-out, and insights reporting. This role sets the operating cadence for weekly sales operations and is accountable for the quality and timeliness of the team's output. You will work closely with Sales leadership, Product GTM, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, and Finance.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

  

**Management Plan (MP) Target breakdown to fit each sales organization**

* Own the end-to-end MP process, including annual and quarterly targets cascaded from top-line revenue to channel, product, and SKU levels.
* Prioritize and manage MP-related workloads and requests from leadership, Sales, and Finance, setting timelines and deliverables for the team.
* Monthly TP (target plan) and weekly DP (demand plan) link with each sales organization, and drive weekly forecast and target tracking calls by product category (HHP, Tab, PC).
Align the RR forecast with MP commitments, and flag gaps to leadership early with a recommended path to close them.  

  

**MBO**

* Design and run the MBO cascade for sales teams, linking objectives to measurable KPIs and integrating them with quarterly compensation planning.
* Build and maintain the KPI tracker and scorecard, and report progress in operational and executive reviews.
Manage MBO checkpoints (quarterly) with clean, auditable data, and resolve discrepancies before results are shared.  

  

**CBS Pipeline & Performance**

* Own CBS (Carrier Business) pipeline hygiene and drive pipeline focus across the team, including pipeline close-rate reporting and risk flags.
* Run the S/T and DT pipeline cadence, and connect Sales and sell-through teams on opportunities that lack a clear path to sale.
Lead SKU and product lifecycle analysis (PLC, EOL, Supply constraint) and assess its impact on targets, pipeline, and inventory.  

  

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement process and workflow improvements that increase the efficiency and reliability of the function.
Drive adoption of reporting tools and analytical infrastructure (e.g., Tableau, AI productivity tools), and serve as the escalation point for field-raised data and reporting issues.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, sales strategy, or analytics in a B2B environment
* 3+ years of experience leading or managing a team
* Proven experience owning management planning, target setting, or MBO processes, including cascading goals from top-line to individual level
* Working knowledge of supply chain management (SCM), including sell-in, sell-out, and sell-through metrics, and channel inventory management (WOS, PSI)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, pivot tables, and large-scale data manipulation
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards using Tableau, Alteryx, Excel, or equivalent tools
* Strong command of sales revenue structure, including gross-to-net revenue, deductions, and P&L adjustments
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex data to executive audiences
* Strong PowerPoint skills, with experience owning executive strategy decks and business reviews
Bachelor's degree in Business, SCM, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience in IT Channel, telecom, or consumer technology sales environments
* Familiarity with route-to-market models across IT Channel, Digital, and Direct sales motions
* Knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and exposure to enterprise BI or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle)
* Experience with supply chain planning concepts (e.g., demand signals, safety stock, buffer planning)
Familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis and reporting workflows  

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

You are a builder, a leader, and a connector. You see how revenue moves through the business, and you know how to turn that complexity into clear processes, reliable data, and a team that delivers consistently. You are as comfortable coaching an analyst through a model as you are presenting to a leadership team. You don't just run the numbers. You own them, explain them, and use them to drive better decisions. You thrive in ambiguity, communicate proactively, and take pride in work that other people depend on.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE PART OF**

* A high-visibility Sales Operations function that directly shapes how MX B2B sets goals, plans targets, and measures performance
* Cross-functional partnerships across Sales, Product GTM, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, and Finance
* A team culture that values ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
Travel as required (~10%)  

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR 1**

  

**Own the MP and MBO Cycle**

Within the first six months, you are the recognized owner of the MP and MBO processes. You understand how targets are built, how they flow to the field, and how they connect to compensation. The next planning cycle runs through you.

  

**Be the Source of Truth for CBS and Revenue Performance**

Pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting are consolidated, accurate, and delivered on time. Stakeholders come to you when they need to understand what is happening in the business.

  

**Build a Team That Delivers**

Your team has clear ownership of its cadences and deliverables, and its reporting is trusted by leadership. Team members are developing their skills and taking on more responsibility.

  

**Build Toward Scale**

By year end, you have identified gaps in the existing infrastructure and led improvements, whether that is a more reliable data pipeline, a cleaner forecasting model, or a more consistent planning cadence. The function is more capable than when you arrived.

  

*Work is generally performed in an office environment. This role operates under periodic time-sensitive conditions, including month-end, quarter-end, and planning-cycle deadlines, and may require hours beyond a standard schedule. The position carries significant responsibility and broad access to confidential revenue and business data.*
