Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.  
  
We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required

Title: Warehouse Manager
Description:
### **Job Title:** **Warehouse Manager**

**Department:** Operations
  
**Location:** NEP Middle East – Dubai, UAE  
**Reports to:** Head of Operations MEA  
**Direct Reports:** Warehouse Assistants, Drivers, Freelancers (as needed)

### **Role Overview:**

As **Warehouse Manager** at NEP Middle East, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of the warehouse to ensure efficient, accurate, and safe handling of broadcast equipment and materials. You will manage the dispatch, receipt, storage, and return processes, while coordinating closely with the technical and production teams to support the delivery of high-profile events and productions.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Warehouse Operations & Coordination**

* Supervise daily warehouse activities including equipment check-in/check-out, inventory movements, and preparation for live projects.
* Ensure all incoming and outgoing equipment is accurately scanned, recorded, cleaned, and stored.
* Coordinate loading/unloading, packing, and shipment schedules with internal teams and logistics providers.

**Inventory & Asset Management**

* Oversee inventory control processes including tagging, barcode scanning, and regular cycle counts.
* Maintain accurate stock levels and ensure proper documentation using internal systems (e.g., HERO, ClearCo, etc.).
* Identify and report damaged or missing equipment; coordinate repairs or replacements as necessary.

**Team Supervision & Safety**

* Supervise and schedule the warehouse team, including freelancers and drivers.
* Enforce safety procedures and cleanliness standards within the warehouse.
* Provide guidance and hands-on support for technical packing and operational best practices.

**Cross-Department Collaboration**

* Work closely with operations, engineering, and production teams to ensure equipment readiness and availability for events.
* Support equipment requests for last-minute changes and on-site needs.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate documentation of equipment transfers, dispatch notes, delivery records, and internal forms.
* Provide weekly status reports to management, including inventory levels, issues, and recommendations.

### **Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of warehouse or logistics experience, with **previous experience in the broadcast industry being essential**.
* Strong understanding of warehouse workflows, inventory management systems, and broadcast equipment handling.
* Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and warehouse tracking tools.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.
* Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Proactive team player with strong leadership, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
* Physically fit and capable of performing manual handling tasks when required.

### **Why Join NEP Middle East?**

NEP is a global leader in live and broadcast production services. As part of our warehouse team, you’ll support some of the biggest and most dynamic productions in the region. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment and grow your operational leadership career.

* Carry out all land surveying, topographical surveying, and setting-out activities in accordance with approved construction drawings, project specifications, and survey procedures.

* Conduct detailed topographical surveys to identify existing ground levels, site boundaries, structures, road alignments, and existing utilities.
* Verify contractor's setting-out works and ensure that all construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved coordinates, levels, and alignments.
* Carry out setting-out surveys for roads, highways, roundabouts, junctions, kerbs, footpaths, pavements, and associated infrastructure works.

* Carry out surveys for dry utility installations, including electrical networks, MV/LV cable routes, telecom, fibre optics, street lighting, and ITS infrastructure.

* Carry out setting-out surveys for buildings, infrastructure structures, foundations, retaining walls, and other civil and structural elements.
* Conduct level surveys for road subgrade, subbase, road base, asphalt layers, kerbs, and final finished surfaces.
* Perform as-built surveys for completed infrastructure, roadworks, underground utilities, and structural installations.
* Review and verify contractor's survey submissions, setting-out data, coordinates, levels, and as-built drawings against approved IFC drawings.

The successful candidate will assume full operational and managerial responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations, ensuring exceptional product quality, culinary creativity, operational efficiency, and consistency across all Food & Beverage outlets.

Operating at Chef de Cuisine level, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing the entire pastry and bakery team, developing menus, overseeing production, managing departmental costs, maintaining food safety standards, and driving continuous culinary innovation.

As a key member of the pre-opening team, the Pastry Chef will play an instrumental role in establishing the pastry and bakery kitchens, developing signature offerings, selecting equipment, implementing operational procedures, and building a high-performing culinary team from the ground up.

**Pastry & Bakery Operations Management**

* Assume full leadership and operational responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations.
* Oversee daily production, preparation, presentation, and distribution of pastry and bakery products across all Food & Beverage outlets.
* Ensure consistent quality, taste, presentation, freshness, and portion control in accordance with luxury hospitality standards.
* Manage the production of desserts, artisan breads, viennoiseries, cakes, chocolates, confectionery, and other specialty pastry products.
* Establish production schedules based on occupancy forecasts, outlet requirements, guest preferences, and special events.
* Ensure efficient coordination between pastry, bakery, culinary, restaurant, lounge, and in-room dining operations.
* Maintain exceptional standards of organization, cleanliness, and operational discipline within the pastry and bakery kitchens.
* Monitor production efficiency and ensure timely delivery of products to all relevant outlets.
* Maintain a strong operational presence and provide hands-on leadership during critical production and service periods.

* Create distinctive signature desserts and pastry experiences that reflect the luxury positioning of Basiqat by Mantis.
* Develop seasonal menus incorporating locally sourced ingredients, regional flavors, and contemporary culinary techniques.
* Design premium pastry offerings for restaurant, lounge, in-room dining, afternoon tea, and special guest experiences, as applicable.

* Develop suitable offerings for guests with dietary requirements, including gluten-free, vegan, dairy-free, and reduced-sugar alternatives.
* Conduct regular product tastings, recipe evaluations, and menu development sessions.
* Establish standardized recipes, production methods, presentation guidelines, and portion specifications.
* Monitor international pastry trends and introduce innovative techniques and products that enhance the resort's culinary reputation.
* Collaborate with Culinary and Food & Beverage leadership on menu engineering, promotional activities, and signature dining experiences.

* Lead the establishment and operational setup of the pastry and bakery kitchens during the resort's pre-opening phase.
* Develop and implement departmental standard operating procedures, production workflows, recipe manuals, and operational checklists.

Title: Office Coordinator - MENA

The MENA Office Coordinator provides practical, hands-on administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of Flint Culture's Dubai office and wider MENA operations.

Reporting to the Global Operations Manager and working closely with the HR Director and Finance team, the role supports office coordination, employee administration, compliance tracking, travel arrangements and general operational activities.

We're looking for someone who is naturally proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused - someone who thinks ahead, spots potential issues early and takes the initiative to find practical solutions. This is a varied role for someone who enjoys making things happen, takes pride in being organised and can work independently, using good judgement and knowing when to seek guidance.

Ideally, candidates will already hold valid UAE residency sponsorship and have their own medical insurance cover.

**General Administration & Operational Support**

* Help coordinate day-to-day operational tasks and follow up on outstanding actions.
* Provide general administrative support to the Global Operations Manager and wider team as required.

**Compliance & Renewal Administration**

* Maintain and update the Business Compliance & Renewals calendar, including company licences, registrations, visas and insurance renewals.
* Track important dates, organise supporting documentation and flag upcoming deadlines.
* Liaise with PROs, government service providers and internal colleagues to coordinate visa applications for new joiners, renewals, registrations and other required submissions, ensuring documentation is complete and deadlines are met.
* Ensure records and documentation are accurately maintained and filed.

**HR Administration**

* Support employee on-boarding and off-boarding, including local documentation, visas, insurance and practical arrangements.
* Use Shapes, our HR system, to coordinate and track onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring tasks are completed and records kept up to date.

**IT & Equipment Coordination**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of company equipment, including allocations, returns and replacements.
* Liaise with external IT support to coordinate equipment setup, resolve basic technical issues and ensure timely removal of access for leavers.

* Ensure invoices, receipts and supporting documentation are provided to Finance.

We're looking for someone who:

* *Is a natural problem solver* - approaches challenges with curiosity, common sense and a can-do attitude.
* *Thinks ahead and takes initiative* - anticipates what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
* *Is resourceful and solutions-focused* - looks for practical ways to resolve issues and brings suggestions when flagging problems.
* *Takes ownership* - follows tasks through to completion and doesn't let things fall between the cracks.
* *Is highly organised and detail-oriented* - stays on top of deadlines, records and competing priorities.
* *Is numerically confident and financially aware* - comfortable working with figures, understands the importance of budgets and costs, and has a good head for numbers.

* *Is adaptable and willing to learn* - comfortable with technology, new systems and changing priorities.

* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to handle confidential information securely.
* Confidence using Google Workspace or similar office applications.

* Comfortable liaising with colleagues, suppliers and external service providers.

### **Why join us?**

  

* People first approach - we want to develop a deep sense of belonging & inclusion for all our people.

Title: GRC Consultant
Description:
GRC Consultant – Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:** Fourth Command  
**Client:** Reputed Government Organization in Qatar  
**Job Location:** Qatar  
**Number of Vacancies:** 4  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Employment Benefits:** Accommodation, Health Insurance and Employment Visa will be provided.

1. Job Overview

Fourth Command is seeking qualified and technically competent Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultants for a cybersecurity consulting engagement with a reputed government organization in Qatar.

The position requires strong technical and functional expertise in information security governance, cybersecurity risk management, regulatory compliance, security architecture, information security auditing, and cybersecurity training and awareness.

The selected candidates will be responsible for assessing the organization's cybersecurity posture, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying security and compliance deficiencies, developing governance frameworks, and recommending appropriate security improvements.

Candidates must possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, with the ability to independently conduct assessments, manage stakeholder engagements, deliver cybersecurity training, and prepare professional consulting deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

2. Key Responsibilities2.1. Information Security Governance

* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Support the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Develop cybersecurity strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance processes, and security improvement plans.
* Establish information security roles, responsibilities, accountability mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of information security policies and governance requirements.

2.2. Cybersecurity Risk Management

* Independently conduct enterprise-level, asset-level, application-level, process-level, and project-specific cybersecurity risk assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and associated business and operational impacts.
* Develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, cybersecurity risk registers, risk treatment plans, and risk acceptance documentation.
* Evaluate security control effectiveness and determine inherent and residual risk exposure.
* Recommend appropriate technical, administrative, and operational controls to mitigate identified risks.
* Monitor risk treatment activities, validate remediation effectiveness, and escalate critical or unresolved risks.

2.3. Regulatory Compliance and Security Audits

* Conduct compliance assessments, gap assessments, security maturity assessments, and internal information security audits against applicable national and international cybersecurity frameworks.
* Assess organizational compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA), NIST CSF, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop compliance matrices, control mappings, Statements of Applicability (SoA), audit reports, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, technical walkthroughs, and evidence-based security control assessments.
* Support regulatory inspections, external audits, and cybersecurity certification initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments, track compliance deficiencies, and validate the implementation of corrective actions.

2.4. Security Architecture and Technical Security Assessments

* Review and assess enterprise security architecture, network architecture, infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, and application security architecture.
* Interpret and evaluate network topology diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, data flows, system integrations, and security control placement.
* Identify architectural weaknesses, insecure configurations, inadequate security controls, and potential cybersecurity exposures.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology implementations, infrastructure changes, applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Assess the implementation and effectiveness of technical security controls across the following domains:
* Network Security and Network Segmentation.
* Endpoint and Server Security.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Cloud and Application Security.
* Data Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Vulnerability and Patch Management.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR and XDR.
* Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
* Encryption and Cryptographic Controls.
* System Hardening and Security Configuration.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Review vulnerability assessment reports, penetration testing reports, security configurations, and technical assessment findings to determine associated business risks.
* Evaluate cybersecurity technologies against organizational security requirements and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Apply Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles during security architecture assessments.

2.5. Third-Party Risk Management and Data Privacy

* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments of vendors, suppliers, service providers, and technology partners.
* Review third-party security practices, contractual cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory compliance obligations.
* Develop and maintain third-party risk registers, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
* Assess organizational data protection and privacy practices against applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop and review data classification, information handling, data retention, and data protection requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of data security controls and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

2.6. Business Continuity and Incident Management

* Review and assess Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and cybersecurity incident response plans.
* Support Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and evaluate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Assess organizational preparedness for cybersecurity incidents and operational disruptions.
* Develop and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises, incident response simulations, and business continuity exercises.
* Review incident investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.

2.7. Cybersecurity Training and Awareness

* Develop, implement, and maintain organizational cybersecurity training and awareness programs.
* Independently prepare professional training materials, presentations, educational content, and cybersecurity awareness campaigns.
* Conduct cybersecurity training sessions for employees, management, technical personnel, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop role-based training programs aligned with organizational functions and associated cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct specialized workshops covering cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, data protection, and secure working practices.
* Support phishing simulation exercises and other cybersecurity awareness initiatives.
* Establish training schedules, performance indicators, and mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness.

2.8. Security Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Develop and maintain cybersecurity Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and security performance measurement frameworks.
* Prepare professional risk assessment reports, compliance reports, audit reports, and technical security assessment reports.
* Develop executive dashboards, management presentations, cybersecurity roadmaps, and periodic security performance reports.
* Monitor outstanding cybersecurity risks, compliance deficiencies, remediation activities, and security improvement initiatives.
* Present technical findings, business risks, and security recommendations to technical teams and senior management.

2.9. Stakeholder Management and Consulting

* Independently conduct client meetings, stakeholder interviews, technical discussions, and cybersecurity workshops.
* Coordinate with business functions, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, auditors, and senior management.
* Provide professional cybersecurity advisory services and technically feasible recommendations.
* Effectively communicate complex technical findings and cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned consulting activities, project commitments, and deliverables in accordance with established timelines and quality standards.

3. Required Qualifications and Skills3.1. Education and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* A minimum of three years of directly relevant professional experience in GRC, information security consulting, cybersecurity risk management, or information security auditing.
* Demonstrable experience in independently conducting risk assessments, compliance assessments, information security audits, and technical security control reviews.
* Practical experience in developing security policies, procedures, risk registers, compliance matrices, and professional assessment reports.
* Experience in reviewing security architecture and evaluating technical cybersecurity controls.
* Experience in developing and delivering cybersecurity training, awareness sessions, and stakeholder workshops.
* Previous experience in client-facing consulting engagements, government organizations, or the GCC region will be an added advantage.

3.2. Knowledge of Standards and Regulatory Frameworks

Candidates must possess strong knowledge and practical understanding of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulatory frameworks, including:

* ISO/IEC 27001:2022 – Information Security Management Systems.
* ISO/IEC 27002 – Information Security Controls.
* ISO/IEC 27005 – Information Security Risk Management.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.
* Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA).
* Qatar National Information Security Compliance Framework (NISCF).
* Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.
* ISO 22301 – Business Continuity Management Systems.
* NIST SP 800-53 – Security and Privacy Controls.
* CIS Controls and CIS Benchmarks.
* COBIT – IT Governance and Management.

Practical knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001, cybersecurity risk management methodologies, and security control assessment practices is mandatory. Familiarity with Qatar-specific cybersecurity regulations is strongly preferred.

3.3. Technical Knowledge and Competencies

Candidates must demonstrate strong technical knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, including:

* Enterprise IT infrastructure, network architecture, security architecture, and system integrations.
* Networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation.
* Windows and Linux operating systems, Active Directory, authentication, authorization, and access management.
* Firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, Network Access Control (NAC), and secure remote access technologies.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, and vulnerability management technologies.
* Cloud computing, virtualization, cloud security, and shared responsibility models.
* Application security, API security, and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC).
* Data protection, encryption, system hardening, patch management, and secure configuration.
* Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles.
* Cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, threat intelligence, and incident management.
* GRC platforms, security assessment tools, and reporting technologies.

Candidates must be capable of interpreting technical assessment findings, architecture diagrams, security configurations, and control implementation evidence.

**Candidates with experience limited to documentation or checklist-based compliance assessments, without adequate technical cybersecurity knowledge and practical assessment experience, will not be considered.**

3.4. Communication and Professional Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.
* Strong technical and business writing skills, with the ability to independently prepare professional, client-ready deliverables.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with the ability to conduct training sessions and confidently engage with senior management and government stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively communicate and substantiate technical findings, cybersecurity risks, and security recommendations.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage consulting responsibilities with minimal supervision.

4. Professional Certifications

Candidates possessing one or more of the following professional certifications will be given preference:

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor.
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC).
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* ISO 22301 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer.
* CompTIA Security+.

Professional certifications must be supported by relevant practical experience and technical cybersecurity proficiency.

5. Working Model

This is a full-time, on-site cybersecurity consulting position supporting a reputed government organization in Qatar. The selected candidates will work from the designated client premises and coordinate directly with client stakeholders, technical teams, cybersecurity teams, and Fourth Command management.

Candidates must be willing to relocate to Qatar, independently manage assigned responsibilities, adhere to project delivery timelines, and maintain consistent quality across all deliverables.

Strict adherence to organizational policies, confidentiality obligations, government security protocols, and professional conduct requirements is expected throughout the engagement.

6. Employment Benefits

* Accommodation in Qatar.
* Health Insurance.
* Employment Visa.

7. Mindset and Commitment

Fourth Command is seeking disciplined, technically competent, and professionally mature cybersecurity consultants with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality consulting services.

Candidates must demonstrate sound professional judgment, attention to detail, professional integrity, and the ability to independently address cybersecurity and regulatory challenges. A proactive approach to security improvement, stakeholder management, and continuous professional development is essential for success in this position.

Senior HPC ConsultantThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. **Job Description:**

**Senior HPC Consultant**

The Senior HPC Consultant provides hands-on technical expertise and leadership in the deployment, integration and troubleshooting of HPC solutions, with a focus on Linux, HPC schedulers and parallel storage.

  

Working closely with Project Managers and Solution Architects, they translate designs into practical implementations, support delivery planning, manage technical risks and drive testing, customer acceptance and operational handover. The role also provides technical guidance to customers and mentors colleagues across the delivery team.

Provide specialist HPC technology consulting to external customers and internal project teams, with a focus on Linux, workload management and HPC storage. Design, implement, integrate and troubleshoot HPC solutions that meet customer requirements for performance, availability and operational readiness.

Work closely with Project Managers (PMs) and Solution Architects (SAs), providing the technical expertise required to validate designs, plan implementation activities, manage technical risks and deliver successful customer acceptance and handover.

Build trusted customer relationships, contribute reusable technical solutions and share knowledge across the organisation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical implementation, configuration and integration of HPC environments, from deployment readiness through testing, acceptance and operational handover.
* Provide advanced Linux administration and troubleshooting across compute, management and service nodes.
* Deploy, configure and troubleshoot HPC workload managers and schedulers, including Slurm or equivalent platforms.
* Implement and optimise HPC storage solutions, including parallel filesystems such as Lustre and supporting storage infrastructure.
* Investigate complex issues across compute, operating systems, scheduling, storage and networking, coordinating with engineering, support and third-party teams where required.
* Support SAs by reviewing proposed architectures for implementation feasibility, interoperability, performance, scalability and supportability.
* Translate architectural designs into detailed technical configurations, implementation procedures and test plans, raising design gaps or required changes with the SA.
* Support PMs in defining technical work packages, effort estimates, dependencies, prerequisites and resource requirements.
* Provide clear technical progress updates, identify delivery risks early and recommend corrective actions to support project milestones.
* Assess the technical impact of scope changes and provide input to project change control.
* Develop and execute functional, resilience and performance tests against agreed customer acceptance criteria.
* Produce implementation records, configuration documentation, operational procedures and technical handover material.
* Provide technical guidance to customers and delivery teams, explaining complex issues and recommendations clearly.
* Mentor colleagues and develop reusable automation, deployment methods and troubleshooting procedures.
* Contribute specialist technical input to proposals, statements of work and customer workshops.

**Education and Experience Required:**

* 12+ years of relevant professional experience and a master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in computer science or a related discipline; without a master’s degree, 15+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience delivering and supporting complex HPC environments, including technical ownership of deployment, integration, troubleshooting and acceptance activities.
* Experience working alongside PMs, SAs and multidisciplinary engineering teams on customer-facing infrastructure projects.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

**Linux and Cluster Management:**

* Advanced Linux administration skills, including installation, provisioning, system services, kernel and driver configuration, package management and troubleshooting.
* Experience with enterprise Linux distributions such as RHEL or SUSE.
* Understanding of cluster lifecycle management, configuration consistency, patching, monitoring and logging.
* Practical scripting and automation skills using Bash, Python, Ansible or equivalent tools.
* Ability to diagnose performance and stability issues across operating systems, hardware and application dependencies.

**HPC Schedulers and Workload Management:**

* Strong experience with Slurm or an equivalent HPC workload manager.
* Ability to configure partitions or queues, resource allocation, accounting, priorities, fair-share policies and quality of service.
* Experience troubleshooting job submission, scheduling, execution and resource utilisation issues.
* Understanding of CPU, memory and GPU allocation, job placement and workload isolation.
* Ability to work with customers to translate workload requirements into appropriate scheduler configurations and policies.

**HPC Storage:**

* Strong understanding of parallel filesystems, particularly Lustre, including deployment, configuration, administration and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of storage architecture, metadata and data services, client connectivity, high availability and recovery.
* Ability to investigate filesystem performance, capacity and reliability issues.
* Experience with storage benchmarking and workload analysis using tools such as IOR and MDTest.
* Understanding of filesystem striping, I/O patterns and their impact on application performance.

**HPC Infrastructure and Performance:**

* Understanding of HPC compute architectures, high-speed interconnects and their integration with Linux, schedulers and storage.
* Familiarity with technologies such as InfiniBand, Ethernet or Slingshot.
* Working knowledge of MPI environments, software modules and HPC application runtime dependencies.
* Ability to establish performance baselines, interpret benchmark results and isolate bottlenecks.
* Experience with GPU-accelerated environments is desirable.

**Project and Architecture Support:**

* Ability to break technical scope into executable tasks with realistic estimates, dependencies and completion criteria.
* Ability to identify technical risks, explain their delivery impact and propose practical mitigations.
* Ability to review architecture documents and develop detailed implementation specifications aligned with the approved design.
* Clear communication of technical status, blockers and decisions to PMs, SAs, customers and senior stakeholders.
* Understanding of scope management, change control, acceptance criteria and operational handover.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, coordinate specialist contributors and maintain clear ownership of technical actions.

Title: AVP, Retail Products
Description:
**Description**
---------------

  

Reporting to the Vice President & Head of Retail Products and Portfolio Yield Management, Manulife Bank, the AVP, Retail Products is responsible for leading the Bank’s retail product strategy, portfolio performance and transformation agenda across day-to-day banking products and experience, including deposits, credit cards, ATM and debit payments, and unsecured credit strategy. The role has full P&L accountability for the deposit and credit card portfolios, with support from the Pricing and Yield Management team to optimize pricing, margin and portfolio yield. The portfolio represents a significant opportunity to deepen customer relationships, grow primary banking relationships and deliver sustainable earnings growth for Manulife Bank.

  

The AVP, Retail Products bridges strategy and execution. The incumbent sets the direction for the retail product portfolio, makes product, investment and portfolio trade-off decisions, and ensures that product propositions, customer experiences and operating capabilities deliver value for customers and the Bank. The AVP is accountable for overall portfolio growth and financial outcomes, including acquisition, activation, engagement and volume delivery. In fulfilling this role, the incumbent will partner across the Bank, including Pricing and Yield Management, Data and Analytics, Marketing, Sales, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Operations and Delivery, to deliver high-quality products, experiences and business outcomes.

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership (20%)

  

* Develop, monitor and refine the medium- and long-term strategy for the retail product portfolio, aligned to the Bank’s customer, growth and earnings objectives
* Own the strategic product roadmap and prioritize investments across deposits, credit cards, payments, unsecured credit, relationship banking and day-to-day banking experiences
* Define compelling product propositions, features and lifecycle strategies that strengthen the Bank’s competitive position and deepen customer relationships
* Lead the development of investment business cases and recommend the sequencing of initiatives based on customer value, strategic fit, economics, risk and delivery capacity
* Use customer, market, channel and competitive insights to identify opportunities and inform product and portfolio decisions
  

  

Product Portfolio and P&L Management (20%)

  

* Own the full P&L for the deposit and credit card portfolios, including balances, revenue, margin, expenses, losses and profitability
* Establish product-level performance objectives and operating routines to identify opportunities, address performance gaps and improve portfolio economics
* Make portfolio and P&L trade-offs across growth, customer value, risk, pricing, incentives and investment priorities
* Partner with Pricing and Yield Management to establish pricing and promotional guardrails, optimize margin and yield, and balance customer and financial outcomes
* Oversee product lifecycle decisions, including the launch, enhancement, simplification or retirement of products, features and services
* Provide oversight of credit card product operations, vendor performance, ATM and debit payments, and related customer and operational outcomes
  

  

Transformation and Delivery (30%)

  

* Lead the transformation of the Bank’s day-to-day banking products and customer experiences, with a focus on creating simpler, more connected and relationship-led banking experiences
* Drive the introduction of relationship banking capabilities and new product experiences that support customer growth, engagement and deeper primary banking relationships
* Set transformation priorities and ensure delivery plans remain aligned to the product strategy, target customer experience and expected business benefits
* Partner with Technology, Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into clear requirements, prioritized roadmaps and high-quality solutions
* Oversee execution from concept through launch, including planning, readiness, testing, implementation, adoption and benefit realization
* Provide clear updates to senior leadership on progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, financial performance and outcomes
  

  

Leadership and Building a High Performing Team (15%)

  

* Lead a team of product management professionals with accountability spanning customer growth and campaigns, product and P&L optimization, unsecured credit strategy, and day-to-day banking transformation
* Inspire, coach, guide and actively engage employees; establish clear accountabilities, performance standards and decision rights
* Build product management capability through focused development, coaching, career discussions and succession planning
* Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture that encourages constructive challenge, sound judgment and enterprise thinking
* Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners to align priorities, resolve trade-offs and deliver customer and business outcomes
  

  

Governance, Risk and Controls (15%)

  

* Act as the first-line business owner for product regulatory compliance, product controls and the ongoing soundness of the retail product portfolio
* Own and oversee product-related corrective action plans, remediation activities and sustainable control improvements
* Ensure effective vendor and partner oversight, including clear performance expectations, governance, issue management and escalation
* Oversee customer communications, forms, disclosures and product collateral to ensure accuracy, consistency and regulatory compliance
* Maintain effective product approval and lifecycle governance, ensuring risks, controls, customer impacts and operational readiness are considered in all material decisions
* Promote strong operational resilience and ensure material product, customer and operational risks are identified, understood and addressed
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  
  

* 10+ years of progressive banking, product management, financial management or business transformation experience
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics or a related field
* Demonstrated experience leading deposit and credit card product portfolios
* Strong P&L ownership and financial management experience, including the ability to make portfolio trade-offs and deliver profitable growth
* Leadership experience in strategic planning, business casing, product roadmaps, transformation delivery and cross-functional execution
* Demonstrated knowledge of banking regulation, product governance, first-line risk management and control frameworks
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders and partners across the Bank
* Proven people leadership experience, including building capability, developing talent and leading through change
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
  

* MBA or another business-oriented post-graduate qualification is an asset
* Experience with transformation and agile delivery methodologies
* Experience with vendor management, payments, unsecured credit or relationship banking is an asset

Description:
**Who We Are**

At BlueCosmo, we keep people connected where cell coverage ends. From remote adventures to critical business operations, we provide satellite phones, messengers, and data solutions that help people stay connected when it matters most.

As a Roadpost brand, we partner with leading satellite networks, including Iridium and Inmarsat, and offer trusted products like ZOLEO. But we’re more than just a hardware retailer; our business is built on lasting subscriber relationships, with recurring airtime services at the heart of what we do.

We’re focused on growing that connection – bringing new customers on board, keeping existing subscribers engaged, and delivering reliable communication beyond the reach of cellular networks.

**Why This Role Matters**

We sell satellite telephony — Iridium phones, Inmarsat handsets, GO devices, SIM cards, and airtime plans. AI handles the straightforward volume. What reaches you is the stuff that actually needs a human: a phone that won't connect in the field, a SIM that isn't provisioning, a customer who needs to be in the right plan before they fly out tomorrow. The problems that reach you are telephony-based — power, signal acquisition, dialing, SIM provisioning, airtime balances, number management, and device configuration.

Reporting to the MSS Team Lead, you own those issues start to finish, and you take the initiative to pick up what's next. The customers who contact us depend on their satellite device for continuity of communication — sometimes in genuinely remote or high-risk situations. That urgency is part of the job.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Ownership and continuity of communication.** This is the headline quality we hire for. Take the ticket, work it, close it. Customers in the field cannot afford gaps in coverage — that reality should drive how you prioritize. If you can't resolve something, you find out how. You take the lead on the next step rather than waiting for a manager to assign it, point you to a call, or explain what needs to be done. This role is a great fit for people who enjoy that kind of independence.
* **Product and service knowledge.** Know every product we sell and what it does: Iridium and Inmarsat satellite phones, Iridium GO, Beam and ASE docking stations, SIM cards, airtime plans, and the full range of antenna and cabling configurations. Occasionally you'll help customers who are still figuring out what they need — comparing plans, asking about coverage, or deciding between devices. You're not selling; you're helping them land on the right answer. That means knowing our products well enough to give a confident, accurate recommendation without a script.
* **Self-direction and problem solving.** Box in the issue before you start solving it. Triage properly — eliminate what it isn't before you decide what it is. Use the web, manufacturer documentation, forums, and AI tools to find answers. Curiosity and a drive to learn are essential in this role. When a fix doesn't work, you try a new angle rather than repeating the same step. When you genuinely can't resolve something, you escalate with a full brief and still own the customer interaction to closure.
* **Working with AI.** You'll use AI every day — to research problems, find solutions, and learn faster. You'll also judge whether an AI response to a customer is actually right, and flag to our Optimization team when it isn't. Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

Title: Applications Specialist
Description:
**Location:** 120 Martin Ross – Information & Technology Services

**Job Summary:**

The Applications Specialist is responsible for supporting the Lead and Manager in implementing and maintaining TPL’s enterprise applications on premises or in the cloud. The Specialist provides subject matter expertise on a grouping of applications, for either library services or corporate applications, and provides support in the selection and implementation of new applications. The Specialist is also responsible for on-going operational support, which includes problem/incident resolution, routine maintenance, and delivering on enhancement and change requests. The Specialist also supports application roadmap planning and is accountable for maintaining current awareness of vendor product development cycles. In supporting the application portfolio, this Specialist works with business stakeholders to ensure applications deliver value and are meeting business requirements for functionality, availability, and performance.

  

**Assignment:** Working knowledge and experience implementing and supporting Corporate Applications including but not limited to human capital management (HCM), learning management systems (LMS), incident reporting and management system (IRMS) and Microsoft collaboration technologies with proven experience in application configuration, data migration, data mapping and integrations with other systems, system administration and providing technical support.

  

**Duties:**

Under the general direction of the designated Lead, and working within a team structure, this position is responsible for duties in Applications Selection & Implementation and in Applications Management & Support:

**Application Selection and Implementation**

* Working with the Enterprise Project Management Office (ePMO) on new application solution projects, Requests For Proposals (RFP), providing subject matter expertise in solution architecture requirements, design & build, analysis, evaluation, integration, implementation, and transition to operational support.
* Partnering and engaging with application vendors to ensure quality application delivery to meet business requirements.
* Analyzing and translating business requirements into practical technical solutions that fit into the Library’s overall technical architecture, future direction, and strategic plans.
* Participating in business workflow and process discussions in order to translate these to technical solutions
* Creating technical specification and application support documentation
* Creating quality support documentation for new applications and providing training to support team members (including Service Desk staff), for successful transition for application management & support.
* Leveraging emerging technologies, processes, and disciplines to deliver best in class technical solutions, applications, and system integrations
* Working closely with the ITS solution architects, Security, and Enterprise Technology teams during solution design for the assigned application area and projects.

**Applications Management and Support**

* Acting as the Application Systems Administrator and as a technical Subject Matter Expert for assigned applications.
* Providing support, issue resolution, and request management for various applications, while working closely with other internal ITS teams, business, and vendors to resolve incidents and problems requiring multi-department involvement.
* Monitoring critical production processes, technologies, and applications that have high visibility and impact on business operations
* Proactively identifying application risk and mitigation, capacity availability & continuity management. Providing input to organizational disaster recovery and emergency planning.
* Partnering with business and technical groups to support ongoing business requirements.
* Working with the business and ITS lead/manager to assess, scope, prioritize, solution, test and implement application enhancement requests.
* Ensuring all operational activities comply with enterprise, industry, and government standards.
* Creating and maintaining quality support documentation for assigned applications. Ensuring all application changes are thoroughly tested and implemented into production following the Library’s change management process.
* Designing, creating, and maintaining automated reports using modern automation tools and scripting applying sound data analysis methodologies.
* Researching, developing, testing and recommending process improvements and automation solutions for driving efficiencies, stability, cost savings
* Working closely with the ITS team to collaborate on technical issues and solutions and providing knowledge transfer, training, and documentation
* Working closely with library vendors to resolve technical issues, facilitate application upgrades as part of the application life cycle management, and implement software enhancements while holding vendors accountable for contractual obligations and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Participating in regular team, project, business, and committee meetings.
* Evening, weekend and callback work may be required
* Performing other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Up to three years’ post-secondary education in the field of Information Technology
* Minimum of five (5) years related application support experience or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of enterprise-wide business and technical processes
* Proven experience working with designated current TPL applications (either Library or Corporate applications), as defined in the job posting e.g. , (ex. Ceridian HCM, Symphony ILS, Self-checkout, Collection Digitization, Cornerstone LMS, Dynamics GP Finance)
* Proven experience working within established enterprise architecture frameworks in large organizations
* Proven understanding of best practices for applications, data security and ITIL
* Understanding and experience working on projects using Agile and Waterfall methodologies, following SDLC methodology
* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects and assignments with high quality deliverables
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously including the ability to plan and organize work that is in alignment with projects and organizational deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders
* Ability to perform work requiring sound judgement, initiative, and analytical skills
* Ability to visit or work from over 100 Library branches across Toronto

### **Job Highlight**

Timely and high-quality communications products strengthen the visibility, credibility and coherence of UN-Habitat Palestine’s work; improve awareness of programme results among communities, partners and donors; support accountability and knowledge-sharing; and ensure communications outputs meet institutional standards and agreed donor requirements.

### **About the Country/Multi-Country Office**

Governments at the 19th Session of the UN-Habitat Governing Council, adopted by consensus resolution 19/18 calling on UN-Habitat to establish a Special Human Settlements Programme for the Palestinian People (SHSPPP) and a Technical Cooperation Trust Fund (TCTF). The long-term development objective of the SHSPPP is to improve the human settlements conditions of the Palestinian People and in so doing contribute in a modest way to reaching peace, security and stability in the region. At its 23rd session, the Governing Council adopted a resolution requesting UN-Habitat "to further focus its operations on planning, land and housing issues in view of improving the housing and human settlement conditions of Palestinians, addressing the urbanization challenges, supporting the building of a Palestinian State, humanitarian action and peace-building, in the areas where there are acute humanitarian and development needs, identified through technical assessments by UN-Habitat in coordination with all concerned parties".

The United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is the agency for human settlements. It is mandated by the UN General Assembly to promote socially and environmentally sustainable towns and cities with the goal of providing adequate shelter for all. The post is located in the Special Human Settlements Programme for the Palestinian People.

### **Job Specific Context**

With the overall guidance and direct supervision of the Head of Operations, the Communications Officer will support the planning, production, coordination and dissemination of accurate, accessible and timely communications products that showcase UN-Habitat Palestine’s programmes, results and partnerships. The incumbent will work closely with programme and operations colleagues, partners and relevant UN communications focal points, applying UN-Habitat branding, visibility, editorial and information-management requirements.

### **Role Purpose**

The Communications Officer supports the implementation of UN-Habitat Palestine’s communications and visibility activities to promote the organization’s programmes, achievements and partnerships. The role contributes to the development and dissemination of high-quality communications materials, management of digital content, coordination of outreach and event communications, and compliance with UN-Habitat branding and donor visibility requirements. Working closely with programme teams and relevant stakeholders, the incumbent supports effective information sharing, public awareness and the visibility of UN-Habitat’s work in Palestine.

* Support implementation of the office communications and visibility workplan. Maintain a monthly content calendar showing priorities, planned outputs, responsible colleagues and deadlines.
* Draft, edit, proofread and package communications materials in English and Arabic, including social media posts, factsheets, briefs, talking points, presentations and event materials.
* Prepare briefs and coordinate specialist design, photography and audiovisual production with colleagues and approved vendors as needed. Review drafts against the brief and applicable branding and visibility requirements.
* Maintain and update approved digital communication channels and content repositories; schedule and monitor posts and respond or escalate inquiries in line with office protocols.
* Ensure consistent application of UN-Habitat identity and donor visibility requirements across publications, events, signage, digital products and partner-produced materials.
* Provide communications support for workshops, missions, launches, field visits and public events. Prepare key messages and communications materials, coordinate approved coverage and produce post-event communications summaries.
* Gather inputs from programme teams and implementing partners for donor visibility updates, progress reports and knowledge products. Maintain a donor visibility tracker with deliverables, deadlines, clearance status and links to published products or other evidence of delivery.

The successful candidate will support client solutioning, technical integrations, and product deployments while taking ownership of assigned initiatives and driving them through to successful completion.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Why This Role Is Important to Visa:

As Visa expands beyond traditional consumer payments into domestic and cross-border money movement, successful client integration and adoption of new payment capabilities are critical to driving growth.

The Product Analyst will play an important role in supporting the deployment of Visa Direct solutions across financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, and other ecosystem participants.

The role requires an individual who can bridge business and technology, understand complex payment flows, manage multiple stakeholders, and proactively drive initiatives forward.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

Product Solutioning & Technical Support:

* Support end-to-end product solutioning for Visa Direct capabilities, from technical presales and requirements gathering through solution design, integration, testing, and commercial launch.
* Work closely with clients to understand their business requirements, technical environments, and integration needs.
* Support technical solution workshops and guide clients on integrating Visa Direct products into their existing payment infrastructure.
* Develop a strong understanding of Visa Direct APIs and payment capabilities across cards, accounts, wallets, and cross-border solutions.
* Apply knowledge of card payments, tokenization, banking payment rails, SWIFT messaging, cross-border payment flows, and payment processing to support client solution design.
* Assist with API integration, technical validation, testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
* Prepare and review technical documentation, including payment flows, API specifications, solution architecture diagrams, and sequence diagrams.
* Collaborate with internal Product and Technology teams to address technical challenges and identify appropriate solutions.
* Stay informed about product enhancements, emerging payment technologies, and new capabilities relevant to the markets.

Project Management & Delivery Ownership:

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned initiatives, ensuring activities progress from initiation through successful delivery.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, action trackers, and implementation status reports.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion of deliverables and resolution of dependencies.
* Proactively identify project risks, technical blockers, and potential delays, and drive timely resolution.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivery quality.
* Ensure clear accountability, timely follow-ups, and effective communication across stakeholders.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately while proposing practical solutions and recommendations.
* Demonstrate a strong bias toward execution, accountability, and achieving measurable outcomes.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement:

* Engage with financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, technology partners, and other ecosystem participants.
* Support client discussions and technical workshops, translating business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Prepare and confidently present project updates, technical findings, and recommendations to management and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Product, Technology, Implementation, Client Services, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams.
* Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills to align teams and manage competing priorities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman.

Product Analysis & Continuous Improvement:

* Analyze client requirements, technical challenges, and product gaps to identify opportunities for enhancement.
* Support the documentation, assessment, and prioritization of product improvement requests.
* Contribute to reusable technical documentation, solution playbooks, and implementation best practices.
* Identify opportunities to simplify integration processes, improve client onboarding, and accelerate time to market.
* Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve technical analysis, documentation, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Visa Direct Solutions Centre of Excellence.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional product or solutioning experience in payments, banking, fintech, payment processing, or technical product.

* Understanding of SWIFT messaging and cross-border payment concepts, flows, and ecosystem participants.
* Strong Project Management skills.
* Proficiency in Arabic, with strong verbal communication skills for client and stakeholder engagement across the KBO markets.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Job Summary**

* Develop, maintain, and enforce departmental procedures and operational standards.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable business requirements.

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, installation coordination, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage workloads, and meet deadlines.
* Experience leading, coaching, mentoring, and developing employees.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Build collaborative relationships across multiple departments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, and drive process improvements.
* Must communicate effectively via phone, video conferencing, and written communication.
* Frequent use of standard office equipment, including computers, monitors, and telephony devices.
* Must remain in a stationary position for extended periods.
* Occasionally lift and move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

* Experience in telecommunications, technology services, field operations, or a related industry.

We encourage growth from within Visual Edge IT. We seek outside candidates who are driven that we can nurture along a career path and we hire/promote internally. We also have opportunities to develop talent through training programs.
